```python
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin

def parse_listing_page(html: str, page_url: str):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
    records = []

    # Adjust selectors to match target site
    product_cards = soup.select(".product-card")

    for card in product_cards:
        title_el = card.select_one(".product-title")
        price_el = card.select_one(".product-price")
        link_el = card.select_one("a.product-link")
        rating_el = card.select_one(".product-rating")
        brand_el = card.select_one(".product-brand")
        sku_el = card.select_one("[data-sku]")

        title = title_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if title_el else None
        price_text = price_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if price_el else None
        product_url = urljoin(page_url, link_el["href"]) if link_el and link_el.get("href") else None
        rating_text = rating_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if rating_el else None
        brand = brand_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if brand_el else None
        sku = sku_el.get("data-sku") if sku_el else None

        records.append({
            "title": title,
            "price_text": price_text,
            "product_url": product_url,
            "rating_text": rating_text,
            "brand": brand,
            "sku": sku,
            "source_page": page_url,
        })

    return records
```

## `cleaner.py`

This cleans and normalizes raw records.

```python
import re
import pandas as pd

def parse_price(value):
    if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and pd.isna(value)):
        return None
    text = str(value)
    match = re.search(r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)", text.replace(" ", ""))
    if not match:
        return None
    return float(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))


def parse_rating(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value)
    match = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", text)
    return float(match.group(1)) if match else None


def clean_records(records):
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)

    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Standardize columns
    for col in ["title", "brand", "sku", "source_page", "product_url"]:
        if col not in df.columns:
            df[col] = None

    df["title"] = df["title"].astype("string").str.strip()
    df["brand"] = df["brand"].astype("string").str.strip()
    df["sku"] = df["sku"].astype("string").str.strip()
    df["product_url"] = df["product_url"].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Derived numeric fields
    df["price"] = df["price_text"].apply(parse_price)
    df["rating"] = df["rating_text"].apply(parse_rating)

    # Basic cleaning
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_url", "sku", "title"], keep="first")
    df = df[df["title"].notna() & (df["title"].str.len() > 0)]

    # Normalize text
    df["title"] = df["title"].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
    df["brand"] = df["brand"].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)

    # Reorder columns
    preferred = [
        "title", "brand", "sku", "price", "rating",
        "price_text", "rating_text", "product_url",
        "source_page"
    ]
    remaining = [c for c in df.columns if c not in preferred]
    df = df[preferred + remaining]

    return df
```

```python
def save_to_sqlite(df: pd.DataFrame, db_path: str, table_name: str = "products"):

    try:
        df.to_sql(table_name, conn, if_exists="append", index=False)
```

## `main.py`

This orchestrates the whole pipeline.

```python
import pandas as pd

from scraper import crawl_listing_pages, fetch, polite_sleep
from parser import parse_listing_page, parse_detail_page
from cleaner import clean_records
from storage import save_to_sqlite, save_to_csv, save_to_json

def build_dataset(
    listing_url_template: str,
    start_page: int = 1,
    end_page: int = 5,
    scrape_detail_pages: bool = False,
):
    raw_records = []

    listing_pages = crawl_listing_pages(
        base_url=listing_url_template,
        start_page=start_page,
        end_page=end_page,
    )

    for page_url, html in listing_pages:
        page_records = parse_listing_page(html, page_url)
        raw_records.extend(page_records)

    # Optional detail-page enrichment
    if scrape_detail_pages:
        enriched = []
        for rec in raw_records:
            if not rec.get("product_url"):
                enriched.append(rec)
                continue

            try:
                detail_html = fetch(rec["product_url"])
                detail_data = parse_detail_page(detail_html, rec["product_url"])
                rec.update(detail_data)
            except Exception as e:
                rec["detail_error"] = str(e)

            enriched.append(rec)
            polite_sleep()

        raw_records = enriched

    clean_df = clean_records(raw_records)
    return raw_records, clean_df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example:
    # Replace with the target site's URL pattern
    listing_url_template = "https://example.com/products?page={page}"

    raw_records, clean_df = build_dataset(
        listing_url_template=listing_url_template,
        start_page=1,
        end_page=10,
        scrape_detail_pages=False,
    )

    print(f"Raw records: {len(raw_records)}")
    print(f"Clean rows: {len(clean_df)}")
    print(clean_df.head())

    # Persist outputs
    save_to_csv(clean_df, "products_clean.csv")
    save_to_json(clean_df, "products_clean.json")
    save_to_sqlite(clean_df, "products.db", table_name="products")
```

```python
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

def fetch_rendered(url: str, wait_ms: int = 2000) -> str:

        page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle")
```

```python
import re
import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import requests
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential


# -----------------------------
# Configuration
# -----------------------------
START_URL = "https://example.com/products"
BASE_URL = "https://example.com"
OUTPUT_CSV = "products_cleaned.csv"
OUTPUT_JSON = "products_cleaned.json"

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": (
        "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
        "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
        "Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    )
}

REQUEST_DELAY_SECONDS = 1.0
TIMEOUT = 20
MAX_PAGES = 50


# -----------------------------
# Data model
# -----------------------------
@dataclass
class ProductRecord:
    source_url: str
    product_id: Optional[str]
    name: Optional[str]
    price: Optional[float]
    currency: Optional[str]
    rating: Optional[float]
    reviews_count: Optional[int]
    category: Optional[str]
    brand: Optional[str]
    availability: Optional[str]


# -----------------------------
# HTTP fetching with retry
# -----------------------------
session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update(HEADERS)


@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=1, max=8))
def fetch(url: str) -> requests.Response:
    resp = session.get(url, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp


# -----------------------------
# Parsing helpers
# -----------------------------
def normalize_text(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if text is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text or None


def parse_price(text: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Optional[object]]:
    """
    Extract currency and numeric price from text like:
    '$129.99', 'USD 129.99', '€1,299.00'
    """
    if not text:
        return {"price": None, "currency": None}

    raw = text.strip()
    currency = None

    if "$" in raw:
        currency = "USD"
    elif "€" in raw:
        currency = "EUR"
    elif "£" in raw:
        currency = "GBP"
    else:
        m = re.search(r"\b([A-Z]{3})\b", raw)
        if m:
            currency = m.group(1)

    # keep digits, decimal separators, minus if needed
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^\d.,-]", "", raw)

    # normalize thousand separators
    # e.g. 1,299.00 -> 1299.00
    if cleaned.count(",") > 0 and cleaned.count(".") > 0:
        if cleaned.rfind(".") > cleaned.rfind(","):
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", "")
        else:
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
    else:
        # if only commas, treat as thousand separators unless decimal-like
        if cleaned.count(",") == 1 and len(cleaned.split(",")[-1]) in (1, 2):
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", ".")
        else:
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", "")

    try:
        price = float(cleaned)
    except ValueError:
        price = None

    return {"price": price, "currency": currency}


def parse_int(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"(\d[\d,]*)", text)
    if not m:
        return None
    return int(m.group(1).replace(",", ""))


def parse_float(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", text)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None


# -----------------------------
# Product extraction
# -----------------------------
def extract_product_cards(soup: BeautifulSoup) -> List[BeautifulSoup]:
    # Adjust selector to target product cards on the site
    cards = soup.select(".product-card")
    return cards


def extract_product_from_card(card, page_url: str) -> ProductRecord:
    # These selectors are site-specific and should be adapted
    name_el = card.select_one(".product-title")
    price_el = card.select_one(".product-price")
    rating_el = card.select_one(".product-rating")
    reviews_el = card.select_one(".product-reviews")
    category_el = card.select_one(".product-category")
    brand_el = card.select_one(".product-brand")
    availability_el = card.select_one(".availability")
    link_el = card.select_one("a[href]")

    name = normalize_text(name_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if name_el else None)
    price_info = parse_price(price_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if price_el else None)
    rating = parse_float(rating_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if rating_el else None)
    reviews_count = parse_int(reviews_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if reviews_el else None)
    category = normalize_text(category_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if category_el else None)
    brand = normalize_text(brand_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if brand_el else None)
    availability = normalize_text(availability_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if availability_el else None)

    source_url = urljoin(page_url, link_el["href"]) if link_el and link_el.get("href") else page_url
    product_id = None

    # Try to derive product ID from URL if present
    parsed = urlparse(source_url)
    m = re.search(r"/product/([^/?#]+)", parsed.path)
    if m:
        product_id = m.group(1)

    return ProductRecord(
        source_url=source_url,
        product_id=product_id,
        name=name,
        price=price_info["price"],
        currency=price_info["currency"],
        rating=rating,
        reviews_count=reviews_count,
        category=category,
        brand=brand,
        availability=availability,
    )


def find_next_page(soup: BeautifulSoup, current_url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    next_el = soup.select_one("a.next, a[rel='next']")
    if next_el and next_el.get("href"):
        return urljoin(current_url, next_el["href"])
    return None


# -----------------------------
# Crawling pipeline
# -----------------------------
def crawl_products(start_url: str, max_pages: int = 50, delay: float = 1.0) -> List[ProductRecord]:
    records: List[ProductRecord] = []
    visited = set()
    url = start_url
    page_count = 0

    while url and url not in visited and page_count < max_pages:
        visited.add(url)
        page_count += 1
        print(f"[crawl] Fetching page {page_count}: {url}")

        try:
            resp = fetch(url)
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            print(f"[crawl] Failed to fetch {url}: {e}")
            break

        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")
        cards = extract_product_cards(soup)
        print(f"[crawl] Found {len(cards)} product cards")

        for card in cards:
            try:
                record = extract_product_from_card(card, url)
                records.append(record)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[crawl] Failed to extract card: {e}")

        url = find_next_page(soup, url)
        time.sleep(delay)

    return records


# -----------------------------
# Cleaning / normalization
# -----------------------------
def clean_dataset(records: List[ProductRecord]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in records])

    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Basic cleaning
    for col in ["name", "category", "brand", "availability", "currency", "source_url", "product_id"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Normalize strings
    if "name" in df.columns:
        df["name"] = df["name"].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
        df["name"] = df["name"].str.title()

    if "brand" in df.columns:
        df["brand"] = df["brand"].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
        df["brand"] = df["brand"].str.title()

    if "category" in df.columns:
        df["category"] = df["category"].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
        df["category"] = df["category"].str.title()

    # Deduplicate
    dedupe_keys = ["product_id", "source_url", "name"]
    existing = [c for c in dedupe_keys if c in df.columns]
    if existing:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=existing, keep="first")

    # Type coercion / validation
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df["price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["price"], errors="coerce")

    if "rating" in df.columns:
        df["rating"] = pd.to_numeric(df["rating"], errors="coerce")
        df.loc[(df["rating"] < 0) | (df["rating"] > 5), "rating"] = None

    if "reviews_count" in df.columns:
        df["reviews_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["reviews_count"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

    # Drop rows with missing essential fields if desired
    df = df[df["name"].notna() & (df["name"].str.len() > 0)]

    # Example derived columns
    df["is_in_stock"] = ~df["availability"].fillna("").str.contains("out of stock|unavailable", case=False, regex=True)

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)


# -----------------------------
# Export
# -----------------------------
def save_outputs(df: pd.DataFrame, csv_path: str, json_path: str):
    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)
    df.to_json(json_path, orient="records", indent=2, force_ascii=False)
    print(f"[save] Wrote {len(df)} rows to {csv_path} and {json_path}")


# -----------------------------
# Main
# -----------------------------
def main():
    records = crawl_products(START_URL, max_pages=MAX_PAGES, delay=REQUEST_DELAY_SECONDS)
    print(f"[main] Extracted {len(records)} raw records")

    df = clean_dataset(records)
    print(f"[main] Cleaned dataset has {len(df)} rows")

    save_outputs(df, OUTPUT_CSV, OUTPUT_JSON)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

def fetch_rendered(url: str) -> str:
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle")
        html = page.content()
        browser.close()
        return html
```

Then pass `html` into BeautifulSoup.

```python
import time
import re
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup


class ProductScraper:
    def __init__(self, base_url, listing_path, product_link_selector, next_page_selector=None, delay=1.0):
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.listing_url = urljoin(self.base_url + "/", listing_path.lstrip("/"))
        self.product_link_selector = product_link_selector
        self.next_page_selector = next_page_selector
        self.delay = delay
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update({
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ProductScraper/1.0)"
        })

    def fetch(self, url):
        resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=20)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text

    def parse_listing_page(self, html):
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
        links = []

        for a in soup.select(self.product_link_selector):
            href = a.get("href")
            if not href:
                continue
            links.append(urljoin(self.base_url, href))

        next_page_url = None
        if self.next_page_selector:
            next_el = soup.select_one(self.next_page_selector)
            if next_el and next_el.get("href"):
                next_page_url = urljoin(self.base_url, next_el["href"])

        return links, next_page_url

    def parse_product_page(self, html, product_url):
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

        def text_or_none(selector):
            el = soup.select_one(selector)
            return el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if el else None

        # Update selectors to match the target website
        title = text_or_none("h1.product-title, h1")
        price_text = text_or_none(".price, .product-price")
        sku = text_or_none(".sku, .product-sku")
        brand = text_or_none(".brand, .product-brand")
        description = text_or_none(".description, .product-description")

        # Extract simple attributes from a table or list if present
        attributes = {}
        for row in soup.select(".specs tr, table tr"):
            cells = row.find_all(["th", "td"])
            if len(cells) >= 2:
                key = cells[0].get_text(" ", strip=True).lower()
                val = cells[1].get_text(" ", strip=True)
                attributes[key] = val

        return {
            "url": product_url,
            "title": title,
            "price_text": price_text,
            "sku": sku,
            "brand": brand,
            "description": description,
            "attributes_raw": attributes,
        }

    def crawl(self, max_pages=5, max_products=None):
        visited_products = set()
        all_records = []

        page_url = self.listing_url
        page_count = 0

        while page_url and page_count < max_pages:
            print(f"[listing] {page_url}")
            try:
                listing_html = self.fetch(page_url)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Failed to fetch listing page: {e}")
                break

            product_links, next_page_url = self.parse_listing_page(listing_html)

            for product_url in product_links:
                if product_url in visited_products:
                    continue
                visited_products.add(product_url)

                print(f"  [product] {product_url}")
                try:
                    product_html = self.fetch(product_url)
                    record = self.parse_product_page(product_html, product_url)
                    all_records.append(record)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"  Failed to fetch product page: {e}")

                if max_products and len(all_records) >= max_products:
                    return all_records

                time.sleep(self.delay)

            page_url = next_page_url
            page_count += 1
            time.sleep(self.delay)

        return all_records
```

```python
import re
import pandas as pd


def parse_price(price_text):
    if not price_text:
        return None

    # Examples: "$19.99", "USD 19.99", "19,99 €"
    text = str(price_text).strip()
    text = text.replace(",", ".")
    match = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", text)
    return float(match.group(1)) if match else None


def clean_records(records):
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)

    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Normalize column names
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]

    # Basic cleanup
    for col in ["title", "sku", "brand", "description", "url"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Parse prices
    if "price_text" in df.columns:
        df["price"] = df["price_text"].apply(parse_price)
    else:
        df["price"] = None

    # Drop rows without title or url
    if "title" in df.columns and "url" in df.columns:
        df = df.dropna(subset=["title", "url"])

    # Remove duplicates by URL
    if "url" in df.columns:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["url"], keep="first")

    # Example: flatten raw attributes dict into keys if desired
    if "attributes_raw" in df.columns:
        attrs = df["attributes_raw"].apply(lambda x: x if isinstance(x, dict) else {})
        attrs_df = pd.json_normalize(attrs)
        attrs_df.columns = [f"attr_{c}" for c in attrs_df.columns]
        df = pd.concat([df.reset_index(drop=True), attrs_df.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)

    return df
```

```python
import json

def extract_json_ld_product(html):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
    for script in soup.find_all("script", type="application/ld+json"):
        try:
            data = json.loads(script.string or script.get_text())
            if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("@type") == "Product":
                return data
            if isinstance(data, list):
                for item in data:
                    if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("@type") == "Product":
                        return item
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None
```

```python
# -----------------------------
session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update({"User-Agent": USER_AGENT})


# -----------------------------
# Networking helpers
# -----------------------------
class FetchError(Exception):
    pass


@retry(
    stop=stop_after_attempt(3),
    wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=1, max=8),
    retry=retry_if_exception_type((requests.RequestException, FetchError)),
)
def fetch(url: str) -> str:
    resp = session.get(url, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
    if resp.status_code >= 400:
        raise FetchError(f"HTTP {resp.status_code} for {url}")
    return resp.text


# -----------------------------
# Parsing helpers
# -----------------------------
def normalize_text(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if text is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text or None


def parse_price(text: Optional[str]) -> tuple[Optional[float], Optional[str]]:
    if not text:
        return None, None

    text = text.strip()
    currency = None

    # Detect currency symbols
    if "$" in text:
        currency = "USD"
    elif "€" in text:
        currency = "EUR"
    elif "£" in text:
        currency = "GBP"

    # Keep digits, commas, dots
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^0-9,.\-]", "", text)

    # Handle formats like "1,299.99" or "1.299,99"
    if cleaned.count(",") > 0 and cleaned.count(".") > 0:
        # Assume commas are thousand separators
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", "")
    elif cleaned.count(",") > 0 and cleaned.count(".") == 0:
        # Assume comma may be decimal separator
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", ".")

    try:
        return float(cleaned), currency
    except ValueError:
        return None, currency


def parse_int(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"(\d[\d,]*)", text)
    if not m:
        return None
    return int(m.group(1).replace(",", ""))


def parse_float(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)", text)
    if not m:
        return None
    return float(m.group(1).replace(",", "."))


def is_probably_product_url(url: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.search(r"/product(s)?/", url)) or "product" in urlparse(url).path.lower()


# -----------------------------
# Crawling
# -----------------------------
def extract_listing_links(html: str, current_url: str) -> List[str]:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
    links = set()

    # Common patterns for pagination and product cards
    for a in soup.select("a[href]"):
        href = a.get("href")
        if not href:
            continue
        abs_url = urljoin(current_url, href)
        if is_probably_product_url(abs_url):
            links.add(abs_url)

    return sorted(links)


def extract_next_page(html: str, current_url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

    # rel="next"
    next_link = soup.select_one('a[rel="next"][href]')
    if next_link:
        return urljoin(current_url, next_link["href"])

    # common "next" buttons
    for sel in ["a.next[href]", "li հաջորդ a[href]", "a[aria-label*='Next'][href]"]:
        el = soup.select_one(sel)
        if el:
            return urljoin(current_url, el["href"])

    return None


def crawl_listing_pages(start_urls: List[str], max_pages: int = 50) -> Set[str]:
    seen_pages = set()
    product_urls = set()
    queue = list(start_urls)

    while queue and len(seen_pages) < max_pages:
        url = queue.pop(0)
        if url in seen_pages:
            continue

        print(f"[LISTING] Fetching {url}")
        seen_pages.add(url)

        html = fetch(url)
        links = extract_listing_links(html, url)
        product_urls.update(links)

        next_page = extract_next_page(html, url)
        if next_page and next_page not in seen_pages:
            queue.append(next_page)

        time.sleep(CRAWL_DELAY_SECONDS)

    return product_urls


# -----------------------------
# Product extraction
# -----------------------------
def extract_product_record(html: str, source_url: str, product_url: str) -> ProductRecord:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

    # These selectors are examples; adapt to target site
    title = normalize_text(
        (soup.select_one("h1") or soup.select_one(".product-title") or {}).get_text(" ", strip=True)
        if (soup.select_one("h1") or soup.select_one(".product-title"))
        else None
    )

    brand = normalize_text(
        (soup.select_one(".brand") or soup.select_one("[data-brand]") or {}).get_text(" ", strip=True)
        if (soup.select_one(".brand") or soup.select_one("[data-brand]"))
        else None
    )

    price_text = None
    for sel in [".price", "[data-price]", ".product-price", ".sale-price"]:
        el = soup.select_one(sel)
        if el:
            price_text = el.get_text(" ", strip=True)
            break
    price, currency = parse_price(price_text)

    rating_text = None
    for sel in [".rating", "[itemprop='ratingValue']"]:
        el = soup.select_one(sel)
        if el:
            rating_text = el.get_text(" ", strip=True)
            break
    rating = parse_float(rating_text)

    review_count_text = None
    for sel in [".review-count", "[itemprop='reviewCount']"]:
        el = soup.select_one(sel)
        if el:
            review_count_text = el.get_text(" ", strip=True)
            break
    review_count = parse_int(review_count_text)

    stock_text = None
    for sel in [".stock-status", ".availability", "[itemprop='availability']"]:
        el = soup.select_one(sel)
        if el:
            stock_text = el.get_text(" ", strip=True)
            break
    stock_norm = normalize_text(stock_text).lower() if stock_text else ""
    in_stock = None
    if stock_norm:
        if any(x in stock_norm for x in ["in stock", "available", "ships now"]):
            in_stock = True
        elif any(x in stock_norm for x in ["out of stock", "unavailable", "sold out"]):
            in_stock = False

    category = normalize_text(
        " > ".join(
            [normalize_text(x.get_text(" ", strip=True)) for x in soup.select(".breadcrumbs a, nav.breadcrumb a") if normalize_text(x.get_text(" ", strip=True))]
        )
    )

    return ProductRecord(
        source_url=source_url,
        product_url=product_url,
        title=title or "",
        brand=brand,
        price=price,
        currency=currency,
        rating=rating,
        review_count=review_count,
        in_stock=in_stock,
        category=category,
    )


def scrape_product(product_url: str, source_url: str) -> Optional[ProductRecord]:
    print(f"[PRODUCT] Fetching {product_url}")
    html = fetch(product_url)
    record = extract_product_record(html, source_url=source_url, product_url=product_url)
    time.sleep(CRAWL_DELAY_SECONDS)
    return record


# -----------------------------
# Cleaning / dataset building
# -----------------------------
def clean_dataframe(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()

    # Normalize strings
    for col in ["source_url", "product_url", "title", "brand", "currency", "category"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Title cleanup
    df["title"] = df["title"].fillna("").str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
    df = df[df["title"] != ""]

    # Remove obvious duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_url"], keep="first")

    # Price/rating sanitization
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df["price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["price"], errors="coerce")
        df = df[df["price"].isna() | (df["price"] >= 0)]

    if "rating" in df.columns:
        df["rating"] = pd.to_numeric(df["rating"], errors="coerce")
        df.loc[(df["rating"] < 0) | (df["rating"] > 5), "rating"] = pd.NA

    if "review_count" in df.columns:
        df["review_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["review_count"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
        df.loc[df["review_count"] < 0, "review_count"] = pd.NA

    # Boolean normalize
    if "in_stock" in df.columns:
        df["in_stock"] = df["in_stock"].astype("boolean")

    # Drop rows with no useful identifier
    df = df[df["product_url"].notna() & (df["product_url"] != "")]

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)


def export_dataset(df: pd.DataFrame, csv_path: str, jsonl_path: str) -> None:
    # CSV
    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)

    # JSONL
    with open(jsonl_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in df.to_dict(orient="records"):
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


# -----------------------------
# Main pipeline
# -----------------------------
def run_pipeline() -> pd.DataFrame:
    # 1) Crawl listing pages to collect product URLs
    product_urls = crawl_listing_pages(START_URLS, max_pages=50)
    print(f"Found {len(product_urls)} product URLs")

    # 2) Scrape individual product pages
    records: List[Dict] = []
    for product_url in sorted(product_urls):
        try:
            record = scrape_product(product_url, source_url=START_URLS[0])
            if record:
                records.append(asdict(record))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[ERROR] Failed to scrape {product_url}: {e}")

    # 3) Build dataframe
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)

    # 4) Clean dataset
    df_clean = clean_dataframe(df)

    # 5) Export
    export_dataset(df_clean, OUTPUT_CSV, OUTPUT_JSONL)

    print(f"Saved {len(df_clean)} cleaned records to {OUTPUT_CSV} and {OUTPUT_JSONL}")
    return df_clean


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_pipeline()
```

```python
import re
import json
import time
import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import requests
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup


# -----------------------------
# Configuration
# -----------------------------
BASE_URL = "https://example.com"
START_URL = "https://example.com პროდუქტs"  # replace with real listing URL
OUTPUT_DIR = "output"
HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": (
        "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
        "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
        "Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    )
}
REQUEST_DELAY = 1.0
TIMEOUT = 20


# -----------------------------
# Data model
# -----------------------------
@dataclass
class ProductRecord:
    source_url: str
    product_id: Optional[str]
    name: Optional[str]
    brand: Optional[str]
    price: Optional[float]
    currency: Optional[str]
    rating: Optional[float]
    review_count: Optional[int]
    category: Optional[str]
    availability: Optional[str]
    description: Optional[str]
    image_url: Optional[str]
    scraped_at: str
    record_hash: str


# -----------------------------
# HTTP helpers
# -----------------------------
session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update(HEADERS)


def fetch_html(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    try:
        resp = session.get(url, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"[fetch_html] Failed: {url} -> {e}")
        return None


def normalize_url(base: str, link: str) -> str:
    return urljoin(base, link)


# -----------------------------
# Crawling logic
# -----------------------------
def extract_listing_links(listing_html: str, page_url: str) -> List[str]:
    """
    Extract product detail page links from a listing page.
    Adjust selectors to match the target site.
    """
    soup = BeautifulSoup(listing_html, "lxml")
    links = []

    # Example selector for product cards:
    for a in soup.select("a.product-card, a.product-link, .product a"):
        href = a.get("href")
        if href:
            full_url = normalize_url(page_url, href)
            links.append(full_url)

    # Deduplicate while preserving order
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for link in links:
        if link not in seen:
            out.append(link)
            seen.add(link)
    return out


def extract_next_page(listing_html: str, page_url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Find pagination link to next page.
    """
    soup = BeautifulSoup(listing_html, "lxml")
    next_a = soup.select_one('a[rel="next"], a.next, .pagination a.next')
    if next_a and next_a.get("href"):
        return normalize_url(page_url, next_a["href"])
    return None


def crawl_listing_pages(start_url: str, max_pages: int = 10) -> List[str]:
    """
    Crawl listing pages and collect product detail URLs.
    """
    product_urls = []
    current_url = start_url
    pages = 0

    while current_url and pages < max_pages:
        print(f"[crawl] Listing page: {current_url}")
        html = fetch_html(current_url)
        if not html:
            break

        product_urls.extend(extract_listing_links(html, current_url))
        current_url = extract_next_page(html, current_url)
        pages += 1
        time.sleep(REQUEST_DELAY)

    # Deduplicate
    seen = set()
    deduped = []
    for u in product_urls:
        if u not in seen:
            deduped.append(u)
            seen.add(u)
    return deduped


# -----------------------------
# Parsing helpers
# -----------------------------
def clean_text(value: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value).strip()
    return text or None


def parse_price(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not text:
        return None
    # Remove currency symbols, commas, spaces
    m = re.search(r"(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)", text.replace(",", ""))
    if not m:
        return None
    try:
        return float(m.group(1).replace(",", "."))
    except ValueError:
        return None


def parse_int(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"\d+", text.replace(",", ""))
    return int(m.group()) if m else None


def parse_float(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)", text)
    if not m:
        return None
    try:
        return float(m.group(1).replace(",", "."))
    except ValueError:
        return None


def hash_record(data: Dict) -> str:
    """
    Stable hash for deduplication.
    """
    canonical = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


# -----------------------------
# Product extraction
# -----------------------------
def extract_product_record(product_html: str, product_url: str) -> ProductRecord:
    """
    Extract fields from a product detail page.
    Update selectors to match the target website.
    """
    soup = BeautifulSoup(product_html, "lxml")

    # Common metadata fallbacks
    name = None
    brand = None
    price = None
    currency = None
    rating = None
    review_count = None
    category = None
    availability = None
    description = None
    image_url = None
    product_id = None

    # Title
    title_tag = soup.select_one("h1.product-title, h1[itemprop='name'], .product-name")
    if title_tag:
        name = clean_text(title_tag.get_text())

    # Brand
    brand_tag = soup.select_one(".brand, [itemprop='brand'], meta[name='brand']")
    if brand_tag:
        if brand_tag.name == "meta":
            brand = clean_text(brand_tag.get("content"))
        else:
            brand = clean_text(brand_tag.get_text())

    # Price
    price_tag = soup.select_one(".price, [itemprop='price'], meta[property='product:price:amount']")
    if price_tag:
        if price_tag.name == "meta":
            price = parse_price(price_tag.get("content"))
        else:
            txt = clean_text(price_tag.get_text())
            price = parse_price(txt)

    # Currency
    currency_tag = soup.select_one("meta[property='product:price:currency'], .currency")
    if currency_tag:
        currency = clean_text(currency_tag.get("content") if currency_tag.name == "meta" else currency_tag.get_text())

    # Rating
    rating_tag = soup.select_one(".rating, [itemprop='ratingValue']")
    if rating_tag:
        rating = parse_float(rating_tag.get("content") if rating_tag.has_attr("content") else rating_tag.get_text())

    # Review count
    reviews_tag = soup.select_one(".review-count, [itemprop='reviewCount']")
    if reviews_tag:
        review_count = parse_int(reviews_tag.get("content") if reviews_tag.has_attr("content") else reviews_tag.get_text())

    # Category
    breadcrumb = soup.select(".breadcrumb a, nav.breadcrumb a")
    if breadcrumb:
        category = clean_text(" > ".join(a.get_text(" ", strip=True) for a in breadcrumb[1:])) or None

    # Availability
    avail_tag = soup.select_one(".availability, [itemprop='availability']")
    if avail_tag:
        availability = clean_text(avail_tag.get("content") if avail_tag.has_attr("content") else avail_tag.get_text())

    # Description
    desc_tag = soup.select_one(".description, #description, [itemprop='description']")
    if desc_tag:
        description = clean_text(desc_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True))

    # Image
    img_tag = soup.select_one("img.product-image, meta[property='og:image']")
    if img_tag:
        image_url = normalize_url(product_url, img_tag.get("content") if img_tag.name == "meta" else img_tag.get("src"))

    # Product ID
    id_tag = soup.select_one("[data-product-id], meta[name='product-id'], [itemprop='sku']")
    if id_tag:
        if id_tag.name == "meta":
            product_id = clean_text(id_tag.get("content"))
        else:
            product_id = clean_text(id_tag.get("data-product-id") or id_tag.get_text())

    # Build hash from significant fields
    record_data = {
        "source_url": product_url,
        "product_id": product_id,
        "name": name,
        "brand": brand,
        "price": price,
        "currency": currency,
    }
    record_hash = hash_record(record_data)

    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    scraped_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    return ProductRecord(
        source_url=product_url,
        product_id=product_id,
        name=name,
        brand=brand,
        price=price,
        currency=currency,
        rating=rating,
        review_count=review_count,
        category=category,
        availability=availability,
        description=description,
        image_url=image_url,
        scraped_at=scraped_at,
        record_hash=record_hash,
    )


# -----------------------------
# Cleaning / normalization
# -----------------------------
def clean_dataframe(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Standardize types, remove duplicates, and normalize fields.
    """
    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Basic cleanup
    for col in ["source_url", "product_id", "name", "brand", "currency", "category", "availability", "description", "image_url"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Normalize case
    if "currency" in df.columns:
        df["currency"] = df["currency"].str.upper()

    if "availability" in df.columns:
        df["availability"] = df["availability"].str.lower()

    # Numeric coercion
    for col in ["price", "rating"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    for col in ["review_count"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

    # Remove empty names and duplicates
    if "name" in df.columns:
        df = df[df["name"].notna() & (df["name"] != "")]

    # Deduplicate by product_id if available, else hash
    if "product_id" in df.columns:
        df = df.sort_values(by=["product_id", "scraped_at"], ascending=[True, False])
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_id"], keep="first")
    else:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["record_hash"], keep="first")

    # Drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)


# -----------------------------
# Pipeline runner
# -----------------------------
def run_pipeline(start_url: str, max_pages: int = 10, max_products: Optional[int] = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    print("[pipeline] Crawling listing pages...")
    product_urls = crawl_listing_pages(start_url, max_pages=max_pages)

    if max_products:
        product_urls = product_urls[:max_products]

    print(f"[pipeline] Found {len(product_urls)} product URLs")

    records: List[ProductRecord] = []

    for i, url in enumerate(product_urls, start=1):
        print(f"[pipeline] ({i}/{len(product_urls)}) Scraping: {url}")
        html = fetch_html(url)
        if not html:
            continue

        try:
            record = extract_product_record(html, url)
            records.append(record)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[pipeline] Parse failed for {url}: {e}")

        time.sleep(REQUEST_DELAY)

    # Convert to DataFrame
    df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in records])

    # Clean and dedupe
    df = clean_dataframe(df)

    return df


# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
def save_outputs(df: pd.DataFrame, output_dir: str = OUTPUT_DIR) -> None:
    import os
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    csv_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "products_clean.csv")
    jsonl_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "products_clean.jsonl")

    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)

    with open(jsonl_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            f.write(json.dumps(row.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")

    print(f"[output] Saved CSV:  {csv_path}")
    print(f"[output] Saved JSONL: {jsonl_path}")


# -----------------------------
# Main
# -----------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    df = run_pipeline(START_URL, max_pages=10, max_products=None)
    print(df.head(10).to_string())
    save_outputs(df)
```

## What this pipeline does

### 1) Crawling
- Starts from a listing page
- Extracts product links
- Follows pagination using a “next” link
- Deduplicates product URLs

### 2) Extraction
For each product page, it attempts to parse:
- `name`
- `brand`
- `price`
- `currency`
- `rating`
- `review_count`
- `category`
- `availability`
- `description`
- `image_url`
- `product_id`

### 3) Cleaning
It:

```python
"""
Web scraping pipeline for product listings:
- Crawls listing pages
- Extracts structured product records
- Cleans/normalizes data
- Saves a dataset to CSV and JSONL

Dependencies:
    pip install requests beautifulsoup4 pandas lxml

Notes:
- Check robots.txt and site terms before crawling.
- This example is intentionally generic; you may need to adjust CSS selectors
  for your target site.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Iterable, Optional
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import pandas as pd
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup


# ----------------------------
# Configuration
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class ScrapeConfig:
    base_url: str
    listing_url_template: str  # e.g. "https://example.com/products?page={page}"
    product_link_selector: str  # CSS selector for links on listing pages
    product_card_selector: Optional[str] = None  # optional wrapper selector
    next_page_selector: Optional[str] = None  # CSS selector for pagination "next"
    page_start: int = 1
    page_end: int = 5
    delay_seconds: float = 1.0
    timeout_seconds: int = 20
    user_agent: str = "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ProductScraper/1.0)"
    output_csv: str = "products_cleaned.csv"
    output_jsonl: str = "products_cleaned.jsonl"


# ----------------------------
# Data model
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class ProductRecord:
    source_url: str
    scraped_at: str
    title: str = ""
    brand: str = ""
    price: Optional[float] = None
    currency: str = ""
    rating: Optional[float] = None
    review_count: Optional[int] = None
    availability: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    sku: str = ""
    category: str = ""
    image_url: str = ""


# ----------------------------
# HTTP helpers
# ----------------------------

class Fetcher:
    def __init__(self, config: ScrapeConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update({"User-Agent": config.user_agent})

    def get(self, url: str) -> str:
        resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=self.config.timeout_seconds)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text


# ----------------------------
# Scraping logic
# ----------------------------

class ProductScraper:
    def __init__(self, config: ScrapeConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.fetcher = Fetcher(config)

    def crawl_listing_urls(self) -> Iterable[str]:
        """
        Generate listing page URLs by page number.
        You can switch this to follow 'next' links if needed.
        """
        for page in range(self.config.page_start, self.config.page_end + 1):
            yield self.config.listing_url_template.format(page=page)

    def extract_product_links(self, listing_html: str, listing_url: str) -> list[str]:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(listing_html, "html.parser")
        links = []

        for a in soup.select(self.config.product_link_selector):
            href = a.get("href")
            if not href:
                continue
            full_url = urljoin(listing_url, href)
            links.append(full_url)

        # de-duplicate while preserving order
        seen = set()
        deduped = []
        for link in links:
            if link not in seen:
                seen.add(link)
                deduped.append(link)
        return deduped

    def extract_product_record(self, product_html: str, product_url: str) -> ProductRecord:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(product_html, "html.parser")

        # Generic selectors; customize for your target site
        title = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one("h1"))
        brand = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one(".brand, [data-brand]"))
        price_text = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one(".price, [data-price]"))
        currency, price = self._parse_price(price_text)

        rating_text = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one(".rating, [data-rating]"))
        rating = self._parse_float(rating_text)

        review_text = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one(".review-count, [data-review-count]"))
        review_count = self._parse_int(review_text)

        availability = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one(".availability, [data-availability]"))
        description = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one(".description, #description"))
        sku = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one(".sku, [data-sku]"))
        category = self._text_or_empty(soup.select_one(".category, [data-category]"))

        image = soup.select_one("img პროდუქ?")  # intentionally harmless placeholder? no
        # Use common image selector fallbacks
        image = soup.select_one("img.primary-image, img#main-image, meta[property='og:image']")
        image_url = ""
        if image:
            image_url = image.get("content") or image.get("src") or ""

        return ProductRecord(
            source_url=product_url,
            scraped_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            title=title,
            brand=brand,
            price=price,
            currency=currency,
            rating=rating,
            review_count=review_count,
            availability=availability,
            description=description,
            sku=sku,
            category=category,
            image_url=image_url,
        )

    def scrape(self) -> list[ProductRecord]:
        records: list[ProductRecord] = []

        for listing_url in self.crawl_listing_urls():
            try:
                listing_html = self.fetcher.get(listing_url)
                product_links = self.extract_product_links(listing_html, listing_url)

                for product_url in product_links:
                    try:
                        product_html = self.fetcher.get(product_url)
                        record = self.extract_product_record(product_html, product_url)
                        records.append(record)
                        time.sleep(self.config.delay_seconds)
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"[WARN] Failed product page {product_url}: {e}")

                time.sleep(self.config.delay_seconds)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[WARN] Failed listing page {listing_url}: {e}")

        return records

    @staticmethod
    def _text_or_empty(node) -> str:
        if not node:
            return ""
        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", node.get_text(" ", strip=True)).strip()

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_price(text: str) -> tuple[str, Optional[float]]:
        if not text:
            return "", None

        # Examples: "$19.99", "USD 19.99", "€ 1,299.50"
        currency = ""
        if "$" in text:
            currency = "USD"
        elif "€" in text:
            currency = "EUR"
        elif "£" in text:
            currency = "GBP"

        cleaned = text.replace(",", "")
        m = re.search(r"([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", cleaned)
        if not m:
            return currency, None
        return currency, float(m.group(1))

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_float(text: str) -> Optional[float]:
        if not text:
            return None
        m = re.search(r"([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", text.replace(",", ""))
        return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_int(text: str) -> Optional[int]:
        if not text:
            return None
        m = re.search(r"([0-9]+)", text.replace(",", ""))
        return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


# ----------------------------
# Cleaning / normalization
# ----------------------------

class ProductCleaner:
    def clean(self, records: list[ProductRecord]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in records])

        if df.empty:
            return df

        # Normalize text fields
        text_cols = ["title", "brand", "availability", "description", "sku", "category", "currency", "image_url"]
        for col in text_cols:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = df[col].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
                df[col] = df[col].replace({"nan": ""})

        # Standardize title casing for brand/category if desired
        df["brand"] = df["brand"].str.lower().replace({"": pd.NA})
        df["category"] = df["category"].str.lower().replace({"": pd.NA})

        # Price/rating/review counts coercion
        for col in ["price", "rating", "review_count"]:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

        # Clean obvious duplicates
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["source_url"], keep="first")

        # Basic quality filters
        df = df[df["title"].str.len() > 0].copy()

        # Derived fields
        df["domain"] = df["source_url"].apply(lambda u: urlparse(u).netloc)
        df["has_price"] = df["price"].notna()
        df["has_image"] = df["image_url"].str.len() > 0

        # Optional: remove outliers / invalid prices
        df.loc[(df["price"] <= 0) | (df["price"] > 1_000_000), "price"] = pd.NA

        # Reorder columns
        preferred = [
            "title", "brand", "category", "price", "currency", "rating", "review_count",
            "availability", "description", "sku", "image_url", "source_url", "scraped_at",
            "domain", "has_price", "has_image",
        ]
        cols = [c for c in preferred if c in df.columns] + [c for c in df.columns if c not in preferred]
        return df[cols]


# ----------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------

class DatasetWriter:
    def write_csv(self, df: pd.DataFrame, path: str) -> None:
        df.to_csv(path, index=False)

    def write_jsonl(self, df: pd.DataFrame, path: str) -> None:
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for _, row in df.iterrows():
                obj = row.to_dict()
                f.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


# ----------------------------
# Main pipeline
# ----------------------------

def run_pipeline(config: ScrapeConfig) -> pd.DataFrame:
    scraper = ProductScraper(config)
    cleaner = ProductCleaner()
    writer = DatasetWriter()

    raw_records = scraper.scrape()
    cleaned_df = cleaner.clean(raw_records)

    writer.write_csv(cleaned_df, config.output_csv)
    writer.write_jsonl(cleaned_df, config.output_jsonl)

    return cleaned_df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    config = ScrapeConfig(
        base_url="https://example.com",
        listing_url_template="https://example.com/products?page={page}",
        product_link_selector="a.product-link",   # <-- adjust to target site
        page_start=1,
        page_end=3,
        delay_seconds=1.0,
        output_csv="products_cleaned.csv",
        output_jsonl="products_cleaned.jsonl",
    )

    df = run_pipeline(config)
    print(df.head())
    print(f"\nSaved {len(df)} cleaned records.")
```

```python
import os
import re
import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import List, Optional
from urllib.parse import urljoin

import requests
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

from config import BASE_URL, START_URL, HEADERS, REQUEST_TIMEOUT, SLEEP_SECONDS, MAX_PAGES


@dataclass
class ProductRecord:
    source_url: str
    name: str
    price: Optional[float]
    currency: Optional[str]
    rating: Optional[float]
    review_count: Optional[int]
    availability: Optional[str]
    sku: Optional[str]
    category: Optional[str]
    description: Optional[str]


class ProductScraper:
    def __init__(self):
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update(HEADERS)

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> str:
        resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text

    def parse_listing_page(self, html: str, page_url: str) -> tuple[List[str], Optional[str]]:
        """
        Returns:
            product_urls: list of absolute URLs to product detail pages
            next_page_url: absolute URL to next listing page, or None
        """
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

        product_urls = []
        for a in soup.select("a.product-link"):
            href = a.get("href")
            if href:
                product_urls.append(urljoin(page_url, href))

        next_link = soup.select_one("a.next, a[rel='next']")
        next_page_url = urljoin(page_url, next_link["href"]) if next_link and next_link.get("href") else None

        return product_urls, next_page_url

    def parse_product_page(self, html: str, page_url: str) -> ProductRecord:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

        # These selectors are examples; customize to the target site.
        name = self.safe_text(soup.select_one("h1.product-title"))
        price_text = self.safe_text(soup.select_one(".price"))
        rating_text = self.safe_text(soup.select_one(".rating"))
        review_count_text = self.safe_text(soup.select_one(".review-count"))
        availability = self.safe_text(soup.select_one(".availability"))
        sku = self.safe_text(soup.select_one(".sku"))
        category = self.safe_text(soup.select_one(".breadcrumb a:last-child"))
        description = self.safe_text(soup.select_one(".product-description"))

        price, currency = self.parse_price(price_text)
        rating = self.parse_rating(rating_text)
        review_count = self.parse_int(review_count_text)

        return ProductRecord(
            source_url=page_url,
            name=name or "",
            price=price,
            currency=currency,
            rating=rating,
            review_count=review_count,
            availability=availability,
            sku=sku,
            category=category,
            description=description,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def safe_text(node) -> Optional[str]:
        if not node:
            return None
        text = node.get_text(" ", strip=True)
        return text if text else None

    @staticmethod
    def parse_price(text: Optional[str]) -> tuple[Optional[float], Optional[str]]:
        if not text:
            return None, None
        text = text.strip()

        currency = None
        m = re.search(r"([$€£])", text)
        if m:
            currency = m.group(1)

        number = re.sub(r"[^\d.,]", "", text)
        if not number:
            return None, currency

        # Normalize common formats
        if number.count(",") > 1 and number.count(".") == 0:
            number = number.replace(",", "")
        elif number.count(".") > 1 and number.count(",") == 0:
            number = number.replace(".", "")
        elif "," in number and "." in number:
            # assume commas are thousands separators
            number = number.replace(",", "")
        else:
            # handle 12,99 -> 12.99
            if "," in number and "." not in number:
                number = number.replace(",", ".")

        try:
            return float(number), currency
        except ValueError:
            return None, currency

    @staticmethod
    def parse_rating(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
        if not text:
            return None
        m = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", text)
        return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

    @staticmethod
    def parse_int(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
        if not text:
            return None
        m = re.search(r"(\d[\d,]*)", text)
        if not m:
            return None
        return int(m.group(1).replace(",", ""))

    def crawl(self, start_url: str = START_URL, max_pages: int = MAX_PAGES) -> List[ProductRecord]:
        all_products: List[ProductRecord] = []
        visited_pages = set()
        page_url = start_url
        page_count = 0

        while page_url and page_url not in visited_pages and page_count < max_pages:
            visited_pages.add(page_url)
            page_count += 1

            print(f"[LISTING] {page_url}")
            html = self.fetch(page_url)
            product_urls, next_page_url = self.parse_listing_page(html, page_url)

            for product_url in product_urls:
                try:
                    print(f"  [PRODUCT] {product_url}")
                    product_html = self.fetch(product_url)
                    record = self.parse_product_page(product_html, product_url)
                    all_products.append(record)
                    time.sleep(SLEEP_SECONDS)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"    Failed to parse product {product_url}: {e}")

            page_url = next_page_url
            time.sleep(SLEEP_SECONDS)

        return all_products


def clean_dataset(records: List[ProductRecord]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in records])

    # Basic cleaning
    df["name"] = df["name"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["category"] = df["category"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["availability"] = df["availability"].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Drop obviously bad rows
    df = df[df["name"].notna() & (df["name"] != "")]

    # Remove duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["source_url"])

    # Normalize empty strings to NA
    df = df.replace({"": pd.NA, "None": pd.NA})

    # Type cleanup
    if "review_count" in df.columns:
        df["review_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["review_count"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    if "rating" in df.columns:
        df["rating"] = pd.to_numeric(df["rating"], errors="coerce")
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df["price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["price"], errors="coerce")

    # Example derived column
    df["is_available"] = df["availability"].fillna("").str.lower().isin(["in stock", "available", "yes", "true"])

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)


def save_outputs(df: pd.DataFrame, out_dir: str = "output"):
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    csv_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "products.csv")
    jsonl_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "products.jsonl")

    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)

    with open(jsonl_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            f.write(json.dumps(row.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    print(f"Saved CSV:   {csv_path}")
    print(f"Saved JSONL: {jsonl_path}")


def main():
    scraper = ProductScraper()
    records = scraper.crawl()

    print(f"Scraped {len(records)} raw records")
    df = clean_dataset(records)
    print(f"Cleaned dataset rows: {len(df)}")

    save_outputs(df)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import re
import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import List, Optional
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import requests
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential


# -----------------------------
# Configuration
# -----------------------------
BASE_URL = "https://example.com"
START_URL = "https://example.com/products"
OUTPUT_CSV = "output/products_cleaned.csv"
OUTPUT_JSON = "output/products_cleaned.json"

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": (
        "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
        "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
        "Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    )
}

REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 20
DELAY_BETWEEN_REQUESTS = 1.0  # polite crawling


# -----------------------------
# Data model
# -----------------------------
@dataclass
class ProductRecord:
    product_id: Optional[str]
    name: Optional[str]
    brand: Optional[str]
    price: Optional[float]
    currency: Optional[str]
    rating: Optional[float]
    review_count: Optional[int]
    category: Optional[str]
    product_url: Optional[str]
    image_url: Optional[str]
    availability: Optional[str]


# -----------------------------
# HTTP helpers
# -----------------------------
session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update(HEADERS)


@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=1, max=8))
def fetch(url: str) -> str:
    resp = session.get(url, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.text


# -----------------------------
# Parsing helpers
# -----------------------------
def clean_text(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if text is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text or None


def parse_price(text: Optional[str]) -> tuple[Optional[float], Optional[str]]:
    if not text:
        return None, None

    text = clean_text(text)
    if not text:
        return None, None

    currency = None
    if "$" in text:
        currency = "USD"
    elif "€" in text:
        currency = "EUR"
    elif "£" in text:
        currency = "GBP"

    # Take numeric portion like 1,299.99
    match = re.search(r"([\d,.]+)", text)
    if not match:
        return None, currency

    raw = match.group(1).replace(",", "")
    try:
        return float(raw), currency
    except ValueError:
        return None, currency


def parse_rating(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not text:
        return None
    match = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", text)
    return float(match.group(1)) if match else None


def parse_int(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
    if not text:
        return None
    match = re.search(r"(\d[\d,]*)", text)
    if not match:
        return None
    return int(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))


# -----------------------------
# Scraping logic
# -----------------------------
def extract_product_cards(html: str, page_url: str) -> List[ProductRecord]:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

    # Adjust selector to match the site
    cards = soup.select(".product-card")
    records: List[ProductRecord] = []

    for card in cards:
        name_el = card.select_one(".product-title")
        price_el = card.select_one(".product-price")
        brand_el = card.select_one(".product-brand")
        rating_el = card.select_one(".product-rating")
        reviews_el = card.select_one(".review-count")
        category_el = card.select_one(".product-category")
        link_el = card.select_one("a.product-link")
        image_el = card.select_one("img.product-image")
        availability_el = card.select_one(".availability")

        product_url = None
        if link_el and link_el.get("href"):
            product_url = urljoin(page_url, link_el["href"])

        image_url = None
        if image_el and image_el.get("src"):
            image_url = urljoin(page_url, image_el["src"])

        price, currency = parse_price(price_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if price_el else None)

        record = ProductRecord(
            product_id=get_product_id(product_url),
            name=clean_text(name_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if name_el else None),
            brand=clean_text(brand_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if brand_el else None),
            price=price,
            currency=currency,
            rating=parse_rating(rating_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if rating_el else None),
            review_count=parse_int(reviews_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if reviews_el else None),
            category=clean_text(category_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if category_el else None),
            product_url=product_url,
            image_url=image_url,
            availability=clean_text(availability_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if availability_el else None),
        )
        records.append(record)

    return records


def find_next_page(html: str, current_url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

    # Adjust selector to match the site
    next_el = soup.select_one("a.next-page")
    if next_el and next_el.get("href"):
        return urljoin(current_url, next_el["href"])

    return None


def get_product_id(product_url: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if not product_url:
        return None

    # Example: extract last path segment as ID
    path = urlparse(product_url).path.strip("/")
    if not path:
        return None
    return path.split("/")[-1]


def crawl_products(start_url: str, max_pages: int = 20) -> List[ProductRecord]:
    url = start_url
    page = 0
    all_records: List[ProductRecord] = []

    while url and page < max_pages:
        print(f"Crawling page {page + 1}: {url}")
        html = fetch(url)
        records = extract_product_cards(html, url)
        all_records.extend(records)

        next_url = find_next_page(html, url)
        if next_url == url:
            break

        url = next_url
        page += 1
        time.sleep(DELAY_BETWEEN_REQUESTS)

    return all_records


# -----------------------------
# Cleaning / normalization
# -----------------------------
def records_to_dataframe(records: List[ProductRecord]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in records])

    # Standardize column names/types
    for col in ["name", "brand", "category", "availability", "currency"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Drop empty names/urls
    df = df.dropna(subset=["name", "product_url"])

    # Normalize text
    for col in ["name", "brand", "category", "availability"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True).str.strip()

    # Deduplicate by product URL or product ID if available
    if "product_id" in df.columns:
        df["dedupe_key"] = df["product_id"].fillna(df["product_url"])
    else:
        df["dedupe_key"] = df["product_url"]

    df = df.sort_values(by=["name"]).drop_duplicates(subset=["dedupe_key"], keep="first")
    df = df.drop(columns=["dedupe_key"])

    # Remove obviously invalid prices
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df.loc[df["price"] <= 0, "price"] = pd.NA

    # Optional: enforce numeric types
    df["price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["price"], errors="coerce")
    df["rating"] = pd.to_numeric(df["rating"], errors="coerce")
    df["review_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["review_count"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)


# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
def save_outputs(df: pd.DataFrame, csv_path: str, json_path: str) -> None:
    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)

    with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(df.to_dict(orient="records"), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)


# -----------------------------
# Main
# -----------------------------
def main():
    records = crawl_products(START_URL, max_pages=10)
    print(f"Extracted {len(records)} raw records")

    df = records_to_dataframe(records)
    print(f"Cleaned dataset rows: {len(df)}")

    # Ensure output dir exists beforehand if needed
    save_outputs(df, OUTPUT_CSV, OUTPUT_JSON)
    print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT_CSV} and {OUTPUT_JSON}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## `utils.py`

```python
import re
from urllib.parse import urljoin

def normalize_text(text: str | None) -> str | None:
    if text is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text or None

def parse_price(price_text: str | None) -> float | None:
    if not price_text:
        return None
    # Keep digits, dot and comma; remove currency symbols/transcripts
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^\d,.\-]", "", price_text).strip()
    if not cleaned:
        return None

    # Handle common formats:
    # "1,299.99" -> 1299.99
    # "1.299,99" -> 1299.99
    if cleaned.count(",") > 0 and cleaned.count(".") > 0:
        if cleaned.rfind(",") > cleaned.rfind("."):
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
        else:
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", "")
    else:
        # If only commas, assume comma is decimal if there is one comma and 2 digits after it
        if cleaned.count(",") == 1 and len(cleaned.split(",")[-1]) in (1, 2):
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", ".")
        else:
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", "")

    try:
        return float(cleaned)
    except ValueError:
        return None

def parse_int(text: str | None) -> int | None:
    if not text:
        return None
    digits = re.sub(r"[^\d]", "", text)
    return int(digits) if digits else None

def parse_float(text: str | None) -> float | None:
    if not text:
        return None
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^\d.]+", "", text)
    try:
        return float(cleaned) if cleaned else None
    except ValueError:
        return None

def absolutize_url(base: str, href: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not href:
        return None
    return urljoin(base, href)
```

```python
import time
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from typing import Iterable
from config import ScrapeConfig

class Crawler:
    def __init__(self, config: ScrapeConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update({
            "User-Agent": config.user_agent,
            "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
        })

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> str:
        resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=self.config.timeout_seconds)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text

    def crawl_listing_pages(self) -> Iterable[tuple[str, BeautifulSoup]]:
        for page in range(self.config.start_page, self.config.end_page + 1):
            url = self.config.listing_url_template.format(page=page)
            html = self.fetch(url)
            soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
            yield url, soup
            time.sleep(self.config.request_delay_seconds)
```

```python
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from typing import List
from models import ProductRecord
from utils import normalize_text, parse_price, parse_float, parse_int, absolutize_url

def extract_products_from_listing(listing_url: str, soup: BeautifulSoup) -> List[ProductRecord]:
    products: List[ProductRecord] = []

    # Example selector — change for your site
    cards = soup.select(".product-card")

    for card in cards:
        title_el = card.select_one(".product-title")
        price_el = card.select_one(".product-price")
        brand_el = card.select_one(".product-brand")
        rating_el = card.select_one(".product-rating")
        reviews_el = card.select_one(".product-review-count")
        link_el = card.select_one("a.product-link")
        img_el = card.select_one("img")

        title = normalize_text(title_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if title_el else None)
        if not title:
            continue

        record = ProductRecord(
            source_url=absolutize_url(listing_url, link_el.get("href") if link_el else None),
            product_id=card.get("data-product-id"),
            title=title,
            brand=normalize_text(brand_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if brand_el else None),
            price=parse_price(price_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if price_el else None),
            currency="USD",  # replace with detection logic if needed
            rating=parse_float(rating_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if rating_el else None),
            review_count=parse_int(reviews_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if reviews_el else None),
            availability=normalize_text(
                card.select_one(".availability").get_text(" ", strip=True)
                if card.select_one(".availability") else None
            ),
            image_url=absolutize_url(listing_url, img_el.get("src") if img_el else None),
        )
        products.append(record)

    return products
```

```python
from typing import List
import pandas as pd
from models import ProductRecord

def records_to_dataframe(records: List[ProductRecord]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame([r.model_dump() for r in records])

    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Basic cleanup
    if "title" in df.columns:
        df["title"] = df["title"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True).str.strip()

    for col in ["brand", "availability", "currency"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True).str.strip()

    # Standardize missing values
    df = df.replace({"": pd.NA, "None": pd.NA, "nan": pd.NA})

    # Remove rows without titles
    df = df[df["title"].notna() & (df["title"].str.len() > 0)]

    # Deduplicate by product_id if present, else by title + brand + price
    if "product_id" in df.columns and df["product_id"].notna().any():
        df = df.sort_values(by=["product_id"]).drop_duplicates(subset=["product_id"], keep="first")
    else:
        subset = [c for c in ["title", "brand", "price"] if c in df.columns]
        if subset:
            df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=subset, keep="first")

    # Optional type coercions
    for col in ["price", "rating"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    for col in ["review_count"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

    # Example business rules
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df = df[df["price"].isna() | (df["price"] >= 0)]

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)
```
