```python
import re
import json
import time
import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import requests
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential


# ----------------------------
# Configuration
# ----------------------------
BASE_URL = "https://example.com"
START_URLS = [
    "https://example.com/products",
]
OUTPUT_CSV = "products_cleaned.csv"
OUTPUT_JSONL = "products_cleaned.jsonl"

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": (
        "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
        "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
        "Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    )
}

REQUEST_DELAY_SECONDS = 1.0
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 20


# ----------------------------
# Data model
# ----------------------------
@dataclass
class ProductRecord:
    product_id: str
    name: str
    price: float | None
    currency: str | None
    sku: str | None
    brand: str | None
    category: str | None
    rating: float | None
    review_count: int | None
    url: str
    description: str | None


# ----------------------------
# HTTP helpers
# ----------------------------
session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update(HEADERS)


@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=1, max=8))
def fetch(url: str) -> str:
    resp = session.get(url, timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.text


def sleep_polite():
    time.sleep(REQUEST_DELAY_SECONDS)


# ----------------------------
# Utility functions
# ----------------------------
def normalize_whitespace(text: str | None) -> str | None:
    if text is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    return text.strip() or None


def parse_price(text: str | None):
    if not text:
        return None, None
    text = text.strip()

    currency = None
    if "$" in text:
        currency = "USD"
    elif "€" in text:
        currency = "EUR"
    elif "£" in text:
        currency = "GBP"

    # Extract first numeric value like 1,234.56 or 1234
    m = re.search(r"([0-9]+(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]+)?|[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", text)
    if not m:
        return None, currency

    num = m.group(1).replace(",", "")
    try:
        return float(num), currency
    except ValueError:
        return None, currency


def stable_product_id(url: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.md5(url.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def clean_record(record: ProductRecord) -> ProductRecord:
    # Normalize text fields
    record.name = normalize_whitespace(record.name) or ""
    record.sku = normalize_whitespace(record.sku)
    record.brand = normalize_whitespace(record.brand)
    record.category = normalize_whitespace(record.category)
    record.description = normalize_whitespace(record.description)
    record.url = record.url.strip()

    # Clamp / validate numeric fields
    if record.price is not None and record.price < 0:
        record.price = None

    if record.rating is not None:
        if record.rating < 0 or record.rating > 5:
            record.rating = None

    if record.review_count is not None and record.review_count < 0:
        record.review_count = None

    return record


# ----------------------------
# Crawling listing pages
# ----------------------------
def extract_listing_links(listing_html: str, listing_url: str) -> tuple[list[str], str | None]:
    """
    Returns product links and next page link from a listing page.
    Update selectors for your site.
    """
    soup = BeautifulSoup(listing_html, "lxml")

    product_links = []
    # Example selector: product cards contain <a class="product-link" href="/product/123">
    for a in soup.select("a.product-link[href]"):
        href = a.get("href")
        abs_url = urljoin(listing_url, href)
        product_links.append(abs_url)

    next_url = None
    next_a = soup.select_one("a.next[href]")
    if next_a:
        next_url = urljoin(listing_url, next_a["href"])

    return product_links, next_url


def crawl_listing_pages(start_urls: list[str], max_pages: int = 100) -> list[str]:
    seen = set()
    product_urls = []

    queue = list(start_urls)
    pages_visited = 0

    while queue and pages_visited < max_pages:
        url = queue.pop(0)
        if url in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(url)

        print(f"[LISTING] {url}")
        html = fetch(url)
        sleep_polite()

        links, next_url = extract_listing_links(html, url)
        product_urls.extend(links)

        if next_url and next_url not in seen:
            queue.append(next_url)

        pages_visited += 1

    # Deduplicate product URLs while preserving order
    deduped = list(dict.fromkeys(product_urls))
    return deduped


# ----------------------------
# Product parsing
# ----------------------------
def extract_text(soup: BeautifulSoup, selectors: list[str]) -> str | None:
    for sel in selectors:
        el = soup.select_one(sel)
        if el:
            txt = el.get_text(" ", strip=True)
            if txt:
                return txt
    return None


def extract_product_record(product_html: str, product_url: str) -> ProductRecord:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(product_html, "lxml")

    # Update selectors to match the site
    name = extract_text(soup, ["h1.product-title", "h1", ".product-name"])
    price_text = extract_text(soup, [".price", ".product-price", "[data-testid='price']"])
    sku = extract_text(soup, [".sku", "[data-testid='sku']"])
    brand = extract_text(soup, [".brand", "[data-testid='brand']"])
    category = extract_text(soup, [".breadcrumb li:last-child", ".category"])
    description = extract_text(soup, [".description", ".product-description", "#description"])

    rating_text = extract_text(soup, [".rating", "[data-testid='rating']"])
    review_count_text = extract_text(soup, [".review-count", "[data-testid='review-count']"])

    price, currency = parse_price(price_text)

    rating = None
    if rating_text:
        m = re.search(r"([0-5](?:\.[0-9])?)", rating_text)
        if m:
            try:
                rating = float(m.group(1))
            except ValueError:
                rating = None

    review_count = None
    if review_count_text:
        m = re.search(r"(\d[\d,]*)", review_count_text)
        if m:
            try:
                review_count = int(m.group(1).replace(",", ""))
            except ValueError:
                review_count = None

    record = ProductRecord(
        product_id=stable_product_id(product_url),
        name=name or "",
        price=price,
        currency=currency,
        sku=sku,
        brand=brand,
        category=category,
        rating=rating,
        review_count=review_count,
        url=product_url,
        description=description,
    )
    return clean_record(record)


# ----------------------------
# Dataset building
# ----------------------------
def scrape_products(start_urls: list[str], max_listing_pages: int = 100) -> list[ProductRecord]:
    product_urls = crawl_listing_pages(start_urls, max_pages=max_listing_pages)

    records = []
    seen = set()

    for idx, url in enumerate(product_urls, start=1):
        if url in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(url)

        print(f"[PRODUCT {idx}/{len(product_urls)}] {url}")
        try:
            html = fetch(url)
            sleep_polite()
            record = extract_product_record(html, url)
            records.append(record)
        except requests.HTTPError as e:
            print(f"  HTTP error: {e}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  Parse error: {e}")

    return records


def records_to_dataframe(records: list[ProductRecord]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in records])

    # Final dataset cleaning
    if not df.empty:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["url"])
        df["name"] = df["name"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
        df = df[df["name"] != ""]

        # Optional: filter suspicious prices
        if "price" in df.columns:
            df.loc[df["price"] < 0, "price"] = pd.NA

        # Enforce types
        for col in ["price", "rating"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

        for col in ["review_count"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

    return df


def save_dataset(df: pd.DataFrame, csv_path: str, jsonl_path: str):
    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)

    with open(jsonl_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            f.write(json.dumps(row.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    records = scrape_products(START_URLS, max_listing_pages=50)
    df = records_to_dataframe(records)

    print(df.head())
    print(f"\nScraped {len(df)} cleaned products")

    save_dataset(df, OUTPUT_CSV, OUTPUT_JSONL)
    print(f"Saved: {OUTPUT_CSV}, {OUTPUT_JSONL}")
```

```python
            if isinstance(data, list):
```

```python
import time

class ProductScraper:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        listing_url_template: str,
        product_card_selector: str,
        product_link_selector: str,
        headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        delay_range: tuple = (1.0, 2.5),
        timeout: int = 20,
        max_retries: int = 3,
    ):
        """
        base_url: e.g. "https://example.com"
        listing_url_template: e.g. "https://example.com/products?page={page}"
        product_card_selector: CSS selector for product cards on listing pages
        product_link_selector: CSS selector inside product card for product link
        """
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.listing_url_template = listing_url_template
        self.product_card_selector = product_card_selector
        self.product_link_selector = product_link_selector
        self.headers = headers or {
            "User-Agent": (
                "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
                "Chrome/121.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
            )
        }
        self.delay_range = delay_range
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.max_retries = max_retries

    def _sleep(self):
        time.sleep(random.uniform(*self.delay_range))

    def _get(self, url: str) -> Optional[requests.Response]:
        for attempt in range(1, self.max_retries + 1):
            try:
                resp = requests.get(url, headers=self.headers, timeout=self.timeout)
                resp.raise_for_status()
                return resp
            except requests.RequestException as e:
                if attempt == self.max_retries:
                    print(f"[ERROR] Failed to fetch {url}: {e}")
                    return None
                backoff = 2 ** (attempt - 1)
                time.sleep(backoff)
        return None

    def crawl_listing_pages(self, start_page: int = 1, end_page: int = 5) -> List[str]:
        """
        Collects product page URLs from listing pages.
        """
        product_urls = []

        for page in range(start_page, end_page + 1):
            listing_url = self.listing_url_template.format(page=page)
            print(f"[INFO] Crawling listing page: {listing_url}")
            resp = self._get(listing_url)
            if not resp:
                continue

            soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "lxml")
            cards = soup.select(self.product_card_selector)

            for card in cards:
                link_el = card.select_one(self.product_link_selector)
                if not link_el:
                    continue

                href = link_el.get("href")
                if href:
                    product_urls.append(urljoin(self.base_url, href))

            self._sleep()

        # Deduplicate while preserving order
        deduped = list(dict.fromkeys(product_urls))
        print(f"[INFO] Collected {len(deduped)} unique product URLs")
        return deduped

    def scrape_product(self, product_url: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """
        Extracts structured fields from an individual product page.
        Adjust selectors based on the target site.
        """
        print(f"[INFO] Scraping product: {product_url}")
        resp = self._get(product_url)
        if not resp:
            return None

        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "lxml")

        # Adjust these selectors to match the target website
        title = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one("h1.product-title"))
        price = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".product-price"))
        sku = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".product-sku"))
        brand = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".product-brand"))
        category = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".breadcrumb li.active"))
        description = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".product-description"))
        image_el = soup.select_one(".product-image img")
        image_url = urljoin(self.base_url, image_el["src"]) if image_el and image_el.get("src") else None

        # Example: extract availability
        availability = None
        availability_el = soup.select_one(".availability")
        if availability_el:
            availability = availability_el.get_text(" ", strip=True)

        # Example: extract rating
        rating = None
        rating_el = soup.select_one(".rating")
        if rating_el:
            rating = rating_el.get_text(" ", strip=True)

        return {
            "url": product_url,
            "title": title,
            "price_raw": price,
            "sku": sku,
            "brand": brand,
            "category": category,
            "description": description,
            "image_url": image_url,
            "availability": availability,
            "rating_raw": rating,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _text_or_none(el) -> Optional[str]:
        if not el:
            return None
        text = el.get_text(" ", strip=True)
        return text if text else None
```

## `cleaner.py`

This module converts raw scraped records into a cleaner, more structured dataset.

```python
import re
from typing import Optional

import pandas as pd


def parse_price(price_raw: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not price_raw:
        return None
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^\d.,]", "", price_raw).strip()

    # Handle common formats:
    # 1,234.56 -> remove commas
    # 1.234,56 -> remove dots and replace comma with dot
    if cleaned.count(",") > 0 and cleaned.count(".") > 0:
        # If comma appears after last dot, assume European format
        if cleaned.rfind(",") > cleaned.rfind("."):
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
        else:
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", "")
    else:
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", "")

    try:
        return float(cleaned)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def parse_rating(rating_raw: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not rating_raw:
        return None
    match = re.search(r"(\d+(\.\d+)?)", rating_raw)
    if match:
        try:
            return float(match.group(1))
        except ValueError:
            return None
    return None


def clean_records(records: list[dict]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)

    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Normalize text fields
    text_cols = ["title", "sku", "brand", "category", "availability", "description"]
    for col in text_cols:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Parse numeric fields
    if "price_raw" in df.columns:
        df["price"] = df["price_raw"].apply(parse_price)

    if "rating_raw" in df.columns:
        df["rating"] = df["rating_raw"].apply(parse_rating)

    # Basic cleanup
    df["title"] = df["title"].fillna("").replace("", pd.NA)
    df["url"] = df["url"].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Drop exact duplicates by URL
    if "url" in df.columns:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["url"], keep="first")

    # Remove records without a title or price if required
    # df = df.dropna(subset=["title", "price"])

    # Reorder columns
    preferred_order = [
        "url", "title", "brand", "category", "sku",
        "price_raw", "price", "rating_raw", "rating",
        "availability", "description", "image_url"
    ]
    cols = [c for c in preferred_order if c in df.columns] + [c for c in df.columns if c not in preferred_order]
    df = df[cols]

    return df
```

```python
import os
```

## Full pipeline code

```python
import re
import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import requests
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry


# -----------------------------
# Configuration
# -----------------------------

BASE_URL = "https://example.com"
START_URLS = [
    "https://example.com/products"
]

OUTPUT_CSV = "products_clean.csv"
OUTPUT_JSONL = "products_clean.jsonl"

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": (
        "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
        "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
        "Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    )
}

REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 20
SLEEP_BETWEEN_REQUESTS = 1.0


# -----------------------------
# Data model
# -----------------------------

@dataclass
class ProductRecord:
    product_id: Optional[str]
    name: Optional[str]
    brand: Optional[str]
    price: Optional[float]
    currency: Optional[str]
    rating: Optional[float]
    review_count: Optional[int]
    category: Optional[str]
    product_url: Optional[str]
    image_url: Optional[str]
    description: Optional[str]
    availability: Optional[str]
    scraped_at: Optional[str]


# -----------------------------
# HTTP session with retries
# -----------------------------

def make_session() -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    session.headers.update(HEADERS)

    retries = Retry(
        total=5,
        backoff_factor=0.8,
        status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
        allowed_methods=["GET"]
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries)
    session.mount("http://", adapter)
    session.mount("https://", adapter)
    return session


# -----------------------------
# Utility functions
# -----------------------------

def clean_text(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if text is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text if text else None


def parse_price(text: Optional[str]) -> (Optional[float], Optional[str]):
    if not text:
        return None, None

    text = text.strip()

    # Example matches: "$19.99", "USD 19.99", "€29,90"
    currency = None
    if "$" in text:
        currency = "USD"
    elif "€" in text:
        currency = "EUR"
    elif "£" in text:
        currency = "GBP"

    # Remove everything except digits, commas, dots
    numeric = re.sub(r"[^\d,\.]", "", text)

    # Normalize comma decimal formats like 29,90
    if numeric.count(",") == 1 and numeric.count(".") == 0:
        numeric = numeric.replace(",", ".")
    elif numeric.count(",") > 0 and numeric.count(".") > 0:
        # If both exist, remove thousands separators
        if numeric.rfind(",") > numeric.rfind("."):
            numeric = numeric.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
        else:
            numeric = numeric.replace(",", "")

    try:
        return float(numeric), currency
    except ValueError:
        return None, currency


def parse_int(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"\d+", text.replace(",", ""))
    return int(m.group()) if m else None


def parse_float(text: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"[\d.,]+", text)
    if not m:
        return None
    val = m.group().replace(",", ".")
    try:
        return float(val)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def normalize_url(base: str, link: str) -> str:
    return urljoin(base, link)


def is_same_domain(base: str, url: str) -> bool:
    return urlparse(base).netloc == urlparse(url).netloc


# -----------------------------
# Crawling
# -----------------------------

def fetch_html(session: requests.Session, url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    try:
        resp = session.get(url, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        time.sleep(SLEEP_BETWEEN_REQUESTS)
        return resp.text
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"[WARN] Failed to fetch {url}: {e}")
        return None


def extract_listing_links(soup: BeautifulSoup, base_url: str) -> List[str]:
    """
    Adjust selector to site:
    - product cards
    - anchor to product detail pages
    """
    links = []
    for a in soup.select("a.product-card, a.product-link"):
        href = a.get("href")
        if href:
            abs_url = normalize_url(base_url, href)
            if is_same_domain(base_url, abs_url):
                links.append(abs_url)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(links))


def extract_pagination_link(soup: BeautifulSoup, base_url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Tries to find a 'next' page link.
    Adjust as needed.
    """
    next_a = soup.select_one("a հաջորդ, a.next, a[rel='next']")
    if next_a and next_a.get("href"):
        return normalize_url(base_url, next_a["href"])
    return None


def crawl_listing_pages(session: requests.Session, start_urls: List[str], max_pages: int = 20) -> List[str]:
    visited_pages = set()
    product_urls = []
    queue = list(start_urls)

    while queue and len(visited_pages) < max_pages:
        url = queue.pop(0)
        if url in visited_pages:
            continue

        print(f"[INFO] Crawling listing page: {url}")
        visited_pages.add(url)

        html = fetch_html(session, url)
        if not html:
            continue

        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

        # Product links
        found_links = extract_listing_links(soup, url)
        product_urls.extend(found_links)

        # Pagination
        next_url = extract_pagination_link(soup, url)
        if next_url and next_url not in visited_pages:
            queue.append(next_url)

    # Deduplicate
    return list(dict.fromkeys(product_urls))


# -----------------------------
# Record extraction
# -----------------------------

def extract_ld_json(soup: BeautifulSoup) -> Dict:
    """
    Try to parse JSON-LD if present.
    """
    for script in soup.find_all("script", type="application/ld+json"):
        raw = script.string or script.get_text(strip=True)
        if not raw:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw)
            # Could be list or dict
            if isinstance(data, list):
                for item in data:
                    if isinstance(item, dict):
                        return item
            elif isinstance(data, dict):
                return data
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
    return {}


def extract_product_record(html: str, url: str) -> ProductRecord:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    ld = extract_ld_json(soup)

    # Fallback selectors; customize per site
    name = (
        ld.get("name")
        or clean_text(soup.select_one("h1.product-title").get_text(" ", strip=True) if soup.select_one("h1.product-title") else None)
        or clean_text(soup.select_one("h1").get_text(" ", strip=True) if soup.select_one("h1") else None)
    )

    description = (
        ld.get("description")
        or clean_text(soup.select_one(".product-description").get_text(" ", strip=True) if soup.select_one(".product-description") else None)
    )

    image_url = None
    if isinstance(ld.get("image"), str):
        image_url = ld["image"]
    elif isinstance(ld.get("image"), list) and ld["image"]:
        image_url = ld["image"][0]
    else:
        img = soup.select_one("img.product-image, img.primary-image")
        if img and img.get("src"):
            image_url = normalize_url(url, img["src"])

    brand = None
    if isinstance(ld.get("brand"), dict):
        brand = ld["brand"].get("name")
    elif isinstance(ld.get("brand"), str):
        brand = ld["brand"]
    else:
        brand_el = soup.select_one(".brand, .product-brand")
        brand = clean_text(brand_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if brand_el else None)

    price = None
    currency = None
    offers = ld.get("offers")
    if isinstance(offers, dict):
        raw_price = offers.get("price")
        currency = offers.get("priceCurrency")
        if raw_price is not None:
            try:
                price = float(str(raw_price).replace(",", "."))
            except ValueError:
                price = None
    else:
        price_el = soup.select_one(".price, .product-price")
        if price_el:
            price, currency = parse_price(price_el.get_text(" ", strip=True))

    rating = None
    review_count = None
    agg = ld.get("aggregateRating")
    if isinstance(agg, dict):
        rating = parse_float(str(agg.get("ratingValue")))
        review_count = parse_int(str(agg.get("reviewCount")))
    else:
        rating_el = soup.select_one(".rating")
        if rating_el:
            rating = parse_float(rating_el.get_text(" ", strip=True))
        reviews_el = soup.select_one(".review-count")
        if reviews_el:
            review_count = parse_int(reviews_el.get_text(" ", strip=True))

    availability = None
    if isinstance(offers, dict):
        availability = offers.get("availability")
        if availability:
            availability = availability.split("/")[-1]

    product_id = None
    if isinstance(ld.get("sku"), str):
        product_id = ld["sku"]
    else:
        sku_el = soup.select_one("[data-sku], .sku")
        if sku_el:
            product_id = sku_el.get("data-sku") or clean_text(sku_el.get_text(" ", strip=True))

    category = None
    breadcrumb = soup.select(".breadcrumb a, nav.breadcrumb a")
    if breadcrumb:
        crumbs = [clean_text(a.get_text(" ", strip=True)) for a in breadcrumb]
        crumbs = [c for c in crumbs if c]
        category = " > ".join(crumbs[-3:]) if crumbs else None

    scraped_at = pd.Timestamp.utcnow().isoformat()

    return ProductRecord(
        product_id=clean_text(product_id),
        name=clean_text(name),
        brand=clean_text(brand),
        price=price,
        currency=currency,
        rating=rating,
        review_count=review_count,
        category=clean_text(category),
        product_url=url,
        image_url=image_url,
        description=clean_text(description),
        availability=clean_text(availability),
        scraped_at=scraped_at
    )


# -----------------------------
# Data cleaning
# -----------------------------

def clean_records(records: List[ProductRecord]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in records])

    # Standardize text columns
    for col in ["product_id", "name", "brand", "currency", "category", "availability"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Remove duplicates
    if "product_url" in df.columns:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_url"], keep="first")
    elif "product_id" in df.columns:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_id"], keep="first")

    # Basic validity filters
    df = df[df["name"].notna() & (df["name"].str.len() > 0)]

    # Normalize numeric columns
    for col in ["price", "rating"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    for col in ["review_count"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

    # Example: enforce non-negative prices
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df.loc[df["price"] < 0, "price"] = pd.NA

    # Optional: fill missing currency if obvious
    df["currency"] = df["currency"].replace({"": pd.NA})

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)


# -----------------------------
# Save outputs
# -----------------------------

def save_dataset(df: pd.DataFrame, csv_path: str, jsonl_path: str) -> None:
    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)

    with open(jsonl_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            obj = row.to_dict()
            # Convert pandas NA / NaN to None for JSON
            cleaned = {
                k: (None if pd.isna(v) else v)
                for k, v in obj.items()
            }
            f.write(json.dumps(cleaned, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


# -----------------------------
# Main pipeline
# -----------------------------

def run_pipeline():
    session = make_session()

    # 1) Crawl listing pages to collect product URLs
    product_urls = crawl_listing_pages(session, START_URLS, max_pages=50)
    print(f"[INFO] Found {len(product_urls)} product URLs")

    # 2) Fetch each product page and extract structured record
    records = []
    for i, product_url in enumerate(product_urls, start=1):
        print(f"[INFO] ({i}/{len(product_urls)}) Scraping product: {product_url}")
        html = fetch_html(session, product_url)
        if not html:
            continue
        try:
            record = extract_product_record(html, product_url)
            records.append(record)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[WARN] Failed to parse {product_url}: {e}")

    # 3) Clean and normalize data
    df = clean_records(records)

    # 4) Save dataset
    save_dataset(df, OUTPUT_CSV, OUTPUT_JSONL)

    print(f"[DONE] Saved {len(df)} cleaned records to:")
    print(f"       - {OUTPUT_CSV}")
    print(f"       - {OUTPUT_JSONL}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_pipeline()
```

```python
import re
from urllib.parse import urljoin


def absolutize_url(base_url: str, link: str) -> str:
    return urljoin(base_url, link)


def clean_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(value)).strip()
    return text or None


def parse_price(value):
    if value is None:
        return None, None
    text = str(value).strip()
    currency = None

    if "$" in text:
        currency = "USD"
    elif "€" in text:
        currency = "EUR"
    elif "£" in text:
        currency = "GBP"

    # Remove currency symbols and non-numeric chars except decimal separator
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^\d.,]", "", text)
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(",", "")
    try:
        return float(cleaned), currency
    except ValueError:
        return None, currency


def parse_int(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"[^\d]", "", str(value))
    try:
        return int(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def parse_float(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"[^\d.]", "", str(value))
    try:
        return float(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None
```

```python
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from typing import List, Optional
from models import ProductRecord
from utils import clean_text, parse_price, parse_float, parse_int, absolutize_url


class ProductParser:
    """
    Parser for product listing pages.

    Assumes each product is in a card/container with a consistent structure.
    Update selectors to match the target website.
    """

    def __init__(self, base_url: str):
        self.base_url = base_url

    def parse_listing_page(self, html: str, source_url: str) -> List[ProductRecord]:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
        products = []

        # Example selector; adjust for your target website
        cards = soup.select(".product-card")

        for card in cards:
            product = self._parse_card(card, source_url)
            if product:
                products.append(product)

        return products

    def _parse_card(self, card, source_url: str) -> Optional[ProductRecord]:
        # Example extraction logic; adapt selectors
        link_tag = card.select_one("a.product-link")
        name_tag = card.select_one(".product-title")
        brand_tag = card.select_one(".product-brand")
        price_tag = card.select_one(".product-price")
        rating_tag = card.select_one(".product-rating")
        reviews_tag = card.select_one(".product-reviews")
        availability_tag = card.select_one(".product-availability")
        category_tag = card.select_one(".product-category")

        product_url = None
        if link_tag and link_tag.get("href"):
            product_url = absolutize_url(self.base_url, link_tag.get("href"))

        raw_price = price_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True) if price_tag else None
        price, currency = parse_price(raw_price)

        raw_rating = rating_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True) if rating_tag else None
        rating = parse_float(raw_rating)

        raw_reviews = reviews_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True) if reviews_tag else None
        num_reviews = parse_int(raw_reviews)

        product_id = None
        if product_url:
            product_id = product_url.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]

        return ProductRecord(
            source_url=source_url,
            product_id=product_id,
            name=clean_text(name_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True) if name_tag else None),
            brand=clean_text(brand_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True) if brand_tag else None),
            price=price,
            currency=currency,
            rating=rating,
            num_reviews=num_reviews,
            availability=clean_text(availability_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True) if availability_tag else None),
            category=clean_text(category_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True) if category_tag else None),
        )
```

## `crawler.py`

This module crawls product listing pages and handles pagination.

```python
import time
import requests
from typing import List, Set, Optional
from utils import absolutize_url


class Crawler:
    def __init__(self, base_url: str, headers: Optional[dict] = None, delay_seconds: float = 1.0):
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update(headers or {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ProductScraper/1.0)"
        })
        self.delay_seconds = delay_seconds

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> str:
        response = self.session.get(url, timeout=30)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.text

    def crawl_listing_pages(self, start_url: str, max_pages: int = 10) -> List[str]:
        """
        Returns list of HTML pages from a paginated listing.
        Pagination selector is site-specific and should be adapted.
        """
        pages = []
        visited: Set[str] = set()
        current_url = start_url

        for _ in range(max_pages):
            if current_url in visited:
                break

            visited.add(current_url)
            html = self.fetch(current_url)
            pages.append((current_url, html))

            next_url = self._find_next_page_url(html, current_url)
            if not next_url:
                break

            current_url = next_url
            time.sleep(self.delay_seconds)

        return pages

    def _find_next_page_url(self, html: str, current_url: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Very basic pagination support.
        Update selector for the website being scraped.
        """
        from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
        next_link = soup.select_one("a.next, a[rel='next']")
        if next_link and next_link.get("href"):
            return absolutize_url(current_url, next_link["href"])
        return None
```

## `cleaner.py`

This module deduplicates, standardizes, and removes invalid rows.

```python
import pandas as pd


class DataCleaner:
    def clean(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = df.copy()

        # Normalize column names
        df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]

        # Strip string columns
        for col in df.select_dtypes(include="object").columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()
            df.loc[df[col].isin(["", "None", "nan"]), col] = pd.NA

        # Drop completely empty rows
        df = df.dropna(how="all")

        # Remove duplicates by product_id if present, else by name+brand
        if "product_id" in df.columns and df["product_id"].notna().any():
            df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_id"], keep="first")
        elif {"name", "brand"}.issubset(df.columns):
            df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["name", "brand"], keep="first")
        else:
            df = df.drop_duplicates()

        # Convert numeric columns safely
        for col in ["price", "rating"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

        for col in ["num_reviews"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

        # Filter out rows without a name
        if "name" in df.columns:
            df = df[df["name"].notna()]

        return df.reset_index(drop=True)
```

## `pipeline.py`

This coordinates crawling, parsing, cleaning, and output.

```python
import json
import pandas as pd
from crawler import Crawler
from parser import ProductParser
from cleaner import DataCleaner


class ScrapingPipeline:
    def __init__(self, base_url: str, start_url: str):
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.start_url = start_url
        self.crawler = Crawler(base_url=base_url)
        self.parser = ProductParser(base_url=base_url)
        self.cleaner = DataCleaner()

    def run(self, max_pages: int = 5, csv_path: str = "products.csv", jsonl_path: str = "products.jsonl"):
        pages = self.crawler.crawl_listing_pages(self.start_url, max_pages=max_pages)

        records = []
        for page_url, html in pages:
            products = self.parser.parse_listing_page(html, source_url=page_url)
            records.extend([p.to_dict() for p in products])

        df = pd.DataFrame(records)
        cleaned_df = self.cleaner.clean(df)

        cleaned_df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)
        cleaned_df.to_json(jsonl_path, orient="records", lines=True)

        return cleaned_df
```

```python
import re

    if value is None:

def parse_int(text: str | None) -> int | None:

def parse_float(text: str | None) -> float | None:

        return None
    try:
        return float(match.group(0))
    except ValueError:

def absolute_url(base_url: str, link: str | None) -> str | None:
```

## `src/pipeline/crawler.py`

This crawler fetches listing pages and gathers candidate product links.

```python
import time
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urlencode

from .config import PipelineConfig
from .utils import absolute_url, clean_text


class ProductCrawler:
    def __init__(self, config: PipelineConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update({"User-Agent": self.config.user_agent})

    def build_page_url(self, page_num: int) -> str:
        query = urlencode({self.config.page_param: page_num})
        return f"{self.config.base_url}{self.config.listing_path}?{query}"

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> str:
        resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=self.config.timeout)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text

    def crawl_listing_pages(self) -> list[str]:
        listing_html_pages = []
        for page_num in range(1, self.config.max_pages + 1):
            url = self.build_page_url(page_num)
            html = self.fetch(url)
            listing_html_pages.append(html)
            time.sleep(self.config.delay_seconds)
        return listing_html_pages

    def extract_product_links(self, listing_html: str) -> list[str]:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(listing_html, "lxml")

        links = []
        for a in soup.select("a[href]"):
            href = a.get("href")
            text = clean_text(a.get_text(" ", strip=True))

            # Heuristic: product links often contain /product/ or /p/
            if href and ("/product/" in href or "/p/" in href or "product" in href.lower()):
                links.append(href)

        # De-duplicate and normalize
        normalized = []
        seen = set()
        for link in links:
            abs_link = absolute_url(self.config.base_url, link)
            if abs_link and abs_link not in seen:
                seen.add(abs_link)
                normalized.append(abs_link)

        return normalized

    def crawl_product_links(self) -> list[str]:
        all_links = []
        for listing_html in self.crawl_listing_pages():
            all_links.extend(self.extract_product_links(listing_html))
        return list(dict.fromkeys(all_links))
```

```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

from .models import ProductRecord
from .utils import clean_text, parse_price, parse_float, parse_int


class ProductExtractor:
    def __init__(self, user_agent: str, timeout: int = 20):
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update({"User-Agent": user_agent})
        self.timeout = timeout

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> str:
        resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=self.timeout)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text

    def extract_from_html(self, html: str, source_url: str) -> ProductRecord:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

        title = clean_text(
            self._find_text(soup, ["h1", "[data-testid='product-title']"])
        ) or "Unknown Product"

        brand = clean_text(self._find_text(soup, [".brand", "[data-testid='brand']"]))
        price_text = self._find_text(soup, [".price", "[data-testid='price']"])
        currency = self._detect_currency(price_text)
        price = parse_price(price_text)

        rating_text = self._find_text(soup, [".rating", "[data-testid='rating']"])
        review_count_text = self._find_text(soup, [".review-count", "[data-testid='review-count']"])
        availability = clean_text(self._find_text(soup, [".availability", "[data-testid='availability']"]))

        image_url = None
        img = soup.select_one("img")
        if img and img.get("src"):
            image_url = img.get("src")

        description = clean_text(self._find_text(soup, ["meta[name='description']"]))  # may be blank
        if not description:
            desc_node = soup.select_one(".description, [data-testid='description']")
            if desc_node:
                description = clean_text(desc_node.get_text(" ", strip=True))

        return ProductRecord(
            source_url=source_url,
            product_id=self._extract_product_id(source_url),
            title=title,
            brand=brand,
            price=price,
            currency=currency,
            rating=parse_float(rating_text),
            review_count=parse_int(review_count_text),
            availability=availability,
            image_url=image_url,
            description=description,
            category=self._extract_category(soup),
        )

    def extract_from_url(self, url: str) -> ProductRecord:
        html = self.fetch(url)
        return self.extract_from_html(html, url)

    def _find_text(self, soup: BeautifulSoup, selectors: list[str]) -> str | None:
        for selector in selectors:
            node = soup.select_one(selector)
            if node:
                if node.name == "meta":
                    content = node.get("content")
                    if content:
                        return content
                return node.get_text(" ", strip=True)
        return None

    def _detect_currency(self, price_text: str | None) -> str | None:
        if not price_text:
            return None
        if "$" in price_text:
            return "USD"
        if "€" in price_text:
            return "EUR"
        if "£" in price_text:
            return "GBP"
        return None

    def _extract_product_id(self, url: str) -> str | None:
        # Basic placeholder: use last URL segment
        parts = [p for p in url.rstrip("/").split("/") if p]
        return parts[-1] if parts else None

    def _extract_category(self, soup: BeautifulSoup) -> str | None:
        breadcrumb = soup.select_one(".breadcrumb")
        if breadcrumb:
            text = breadcrumb.get_text(" / ", strip=True)
            return clean_text(text)
        return None
```

## `src/pipeline/cleaner.py`

This cleans, normalizes, and deduplicates records.

```python
import pandas as pd


class DatasetCleaner:
    def clean(self, records: list[dict]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = pd.DataFrame(records)

        if df.empty:
            return df

        # Normalize text
        for col in ["title", "brand", "availability", "description", "category"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

        # Standardize missing values
        df = df.replace({"": None, "nan": None, "None": None})

        # Numeric normalization
        for col in ["price", "rating"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

        for col in ["review_count"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

        # Drop invalid rows
        df = df[df["title"].notna()]
        df = df[df["source_url"].notna()]

        # Deduplicate by product ID or URL
        if "product_id" in df.columns:
            df = df.sort_values(by=["product_id", "source_url"]).drop_duplicates(
                subset=["product_id"], keep="first"
            )

        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["source_url"], keep="first")

        # Add derived fields
        if "price" in df.columns:
            df["price_bucket"] = pd.cut(
                df["price"],
                bins=[-1, 25, 50, 100, 250, float("inf")],
                labels=["0-25", "25-50", "50-100", "100-250", "250+"]
            )

        return df.reset_index(drop=True)
```

## `src/pipeline/pipeline.py`

This orchestrates the end-to-end flow.

```python
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from .config import PipelineConfig
from .crawler import ProductCrawler
from .extractor import ProductExtractor
from .cleaner import DatasetCleaner


class ScrapingPipeline:
    def __init__(self, config: PipelineConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.crawler = ProductCrawler(config)
        self.extractor = ProductExtractor(
            user_agent=config.user_agent,
            timeout=config.timeout
        )
        self.cleaner = DatasetCleaner()

    def run(self, output_dir: str = "data"):
        output_path = Path(output_dir)
        raw_dir = output_path / "raw"
        processed_dir = output_path / "processed"
        raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        processed_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # Step 1: crawl product links
        product_links = self.crawler.crawl_product_links()

        # Step 2: extract raw product records
        raw_records = []
        for url in product_links:
            try:
                record = self.extractor.extract_from_url(url)
                raw_records.append(record.model_dump())
            except Exception as e:
                raw_records.append({
                    "source_url": url,
                    "error": str(e)
                })

        # Save raw records
        raw_json = raw_dir / "products_raw.json"
        with raw_json.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(raw_records, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

        # Step 3: clean dataset
        valid_records = [r for r in raw_records if "title" in r and r.get("error") is None]
        cleaned_df = self.cleaner.clean(valid_records)

        # Save cleaned dataset
        cleaned_csv = processed_dir / "products_cleaned.csv"
        cleaned_parquet = processed_dir / "products_cleaned.parquet"
        cleaned_df.to_csv(cleaned_csv, index=False)
        cleaned_df.to_parquet(cleaned_parquet, index=False)

        return {
            "product_links_found": len(product_links),
            "raw_records": len(raw_records),
            "cleaned_records": len(cleaned_df),
            "raw_json_path": str(raw_json),
            "cleaned_csv_path": str(cleaned_csv),
            "cleaned_parquet_path": str(cleaned_parquet),
        }
```

## `crawler.py`

```python
import time
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin


class ProductCrawler:
    def __init__(self, start_urls, item_link_selector, next_page_selector=None, headers=None, delay=1.0):
        self.start_urls = start_urls
        self.item_link_selector = item_link_selector
        self.next_page_selector = next_page_selector
        self.headers = headers or {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ProductScraper/1.0)"
        }
        self.delay = delay

    def fetch(self, url):
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=self.headers, timeout=30)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text

    def crawl_listing_urls(self):
        seen = set()
        queue = list(self.start_urls)

        while queue:
            url = queue.pop(0)
            if url in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(url)

            html = self.fetch(url)
            soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

            # item links
            for a in soup.select(self.item_link_selector):
                href = a.get("href")
                if href:
                    yield urljoin(url, href)

            # next page
            if self.next_page_selector:
                next_link = soup.select_one(self.next_page_selector)
                if next_link and next_link.get("href"):
                    next_url = urljoin(url, next_link["href"])
                    if next_url not in seen:
                        queue.append(next_url)

            time.sleep(self.delay)
```

```python
import re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from models import ProductRecord


def _parse_price(text):
    if not text:
        return None, None
    text = text.strip()

    currency = None
    if "$" in text:
        currency = "USD"
    elif "€" in text:
        currency = "EUR"
    elif "£" in text:
        currency = "GBP"

    # extract first number like 12.99 or 1,299.00
    m = re.search(r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)", text.replace(" ", ""))
    if not m:
        return None, currency

    price_str = m.group(1).replace(",", "")
    try:
        return float(price_str), currency
    except ValueError:
        return None, currency


def _parse_int(text):
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"(\d+)", text.replace(",", ""))
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def _parse_float(text):
    if not text:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", text)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None


def parse_product_page(html, source_url):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

    # These selectors are placeholders; adapt to the target site
    title = soup.select_one("h1.product-title")
    brand = soup.select_one(".brand")
    price = soup.select_one(".price")
    rating = soup.select_one(".rating")
    review_count = soup.select_one(".review-count")
    availability = soup.select_one(".availability")
    category = soup.select_one(".breadcrumb .active")
    product_id = soup.select_one("[data-product-id]")

    price_value, currency = _parse_price(price.get_text(" ", strip=True) if price else None)

    return ProductRecord(
        source_url=source_url,
        product_id=product_id.get("data-product-id") if product_id else None,
        title=title.get_text(" ", strip=True) if title else None,
        brand=brand.get_text(" ", strip=True) if brand else None,
        price=price_value,
        currency=currency,
        rating=_parse_float(rating.get_text(" ", strip=True) if rating else None),
        review_count=_parse_int(review_count.get_text(" ", strip=True) if review_count else None),
        availability=availability.get_text(" ", strip=True) if availability else None,
```

```python
import pandas as pd


def clean_products(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()

    # Standardize text columns
    text_cols = ["title", "brand", "currency", "availability", "category", "source_url", "product_id"]
    for col in text_cols:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Normalize title and brand capitalization
    if "title" in df.columns:
        df["title"] = df["title"].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
    if "brand" in df.columns:
        df["brand"] = df["brand"].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)

    # Remove obvious invalid prices
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df.loc[(df["price"] < 0) | (df["price"] > 1_000_000), "price"] = pd.NA

    # Review count should be non-negative
    if "review_count" in df.columns:
        df.loc[df["review_count"] < 0, "review_count"] = pd.NA

    # Drop duplicates
    dedupe_cols = [c for c in ["product_id", "source_url"] if c in df.columns]
    if dedupe_cols:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=dedupe_cols, keep="first")

    # Basic missingness handling
    if "title" in df.columns:
        df = df[df["title"].notna() & (df["title"].str.len() > 0)]

    # Optional: fill missing currency if only one currency is observed
    if "currency" in df.columns:
        currencies = df["currency"].dropna().unique()
        if len(currencies) == 1:
            df["currency"] = df["currency"].fillna(currencies[0])

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)
```

```python
def join_url(base_url: str, link: str) -> str:

    if not text:
        return None, None

    # Extract numeric value
```

```python
            currency=currency,
            rating=rating,

        products.append(product)

    # Pagination
    next_page_el = soup.select_one("a.next[href]")
```

## 6) Crawler

The crawler fetches pages and iterates through pagination.

`crawler.py`

```python
import time
import requests

DEFAULT_HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ProductScraper/1.0)"
}

class Crawler:
    def __init__(self, delay=1.0, timeout=20):
        self.delay = delay
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update(DEFAULT_HEADERS)

    def fetch(self, url: str):
        resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=self.timeout)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text

    def crawl_listing_pages(self, start_url: str, max_pages: int = 10):
        url = start_url
        page_count = 0

        while url and page_count < max_pages:
            html = self.fetch(url)
            yield url, html
            page_count += 1
            time.sleep(self.delay)
```

```python
import pandas as pd

def clean_products(records):
    df = pd.DataFrame([r.to_dict() if hasattr(r, "to_dict") else r for r in records])

    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Normalize text columns
    for col in ["name", "availability", "category", "currency"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Drop obviously invalid records
    if "name" in df.columns:
        df = df[df["name"].notna() & (df["name"] != "")]

    # Standardize numeric columns
    for col in ["price", "rating"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    if "review_count" in df.columns:
        df["review_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["review_count"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

    # Remove duplicates by source_url + name
    subset = [c for c in ["source_url", "name"] if c in df.columns]
    if subset:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=subset)

    # Basic missing value handling
    if "currency" in df.columns:
        df["currency"] = df["currency"].fillna("UNKNOWN")

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)
```

```python
import json
from pathlib import Path

from crawler import Crawler
from parser import parse_listing_page
from cleaner import clean_products

START_URL = "https://example.com/products"
MAX_PAGES = 5

RAW_OUT = Path("output/raw_products.jsonl")
CLEAN_OUT = Path("output/cleaned_products.csv")

def ensure_output_dir():
    RAW_OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def save_raw(records, path):
    with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in records:
            f.write(json.dumps(r.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

def main():
    ensure_output_dir()

    crawler = Crawler(delay=1.0)
    all_records = []

    for page_url, html in crawler.crawl_listing_pages(START_URL, max_pages=MAX_PAGES):
        records, next_page = parse_listing_page(html, page_url)
        all_records.extend(records)
        save_raw(records, RAW_OUT)
        print(f"Scraped {len(records)} records from {page_url}")

        # If parse_listing_page already discovers next page, you can switch to a manual loop.
        # Here crawl_listing_pages handles iteration, so next_page isn't used.
        # It’s left in the parser for future flexibility.

    cleaned_df = clean_products(all_records)
    cleaned_df.to_csv(CLEAN_OUT, index=False)
    print(f"Saved cleaned dataset with {len(cleaned_df)} rows to {CLEAN_OUT}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## `crawler.py`

This module discovers listing pages and collects product page links.

```python
import time
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from tensio nty import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_fixed

from config import HEADERS, REQUEST_TIMEOUT, SLEEP_BETWEEN_REQUESTS

@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_fixed(2))
def fetch_html(url: str) -> str:
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.text

def crawl_listing_pages(base_url: str, max_pages: int = 5):
    product_links = set()

    for page in range(1, max_pages + 1):
        url = f"{base_url}?page={page}"
        print(f"[crawl] Fetching listing page: {url}")

        html = fetch_html(url)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

        # Adjust selector to target site
        for a in soup.select("a.product-link"):
            href = a.get("href")
            if href:
                product_links.add(urljoin(base_url, href))

        time.sleep(SLEEP_BETWEEN_REQUESTS)

    return sorted(product_links)
```

> Note: Replace `a.product-link` with the actual product card link selector for your target site.

## `extractor.py`

This module visits each product page and extracts structured fields.

```python
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import re

from models import ProductRecord
from crawler import fetch_html

def clean_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = " ".join(value.split())
    return text if text else None

def extract_price(text):
    if not text:
        return None, None
    # Basic parsing example: "$19.99", "USD 19.99"
    match = re.search(r'([A-Z]{3}|[$€£])?\s*([\d,.]+)', text)
    if not match:
        return None, None
    currency = match.group(1)
    price = match.group(2).replace(",", "")
    return price, currency

def extract_product_record(product_url: str) -> ProductRecord:
    html = fetch_html(product_url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

    # Adjust selectors to target site
    name_el = soup.select_one("h1.product-title")
    price_el = soup.select_one(".product-price")
    rating_el = soup.select_one(".rating")
    review_count_el = soup.select_one(".review-count")
    category_el = soup.select_one(".breadcrumb .active")
    availability_el = soup.select_one(".availability")
    description_el = soup.select_one(".product-description")

    name = clean_text(name_el.get_text()) if name_el else None
    raw_price = clean_text(price_el.get_text()) if price_el else None
    price, currency = extract_price(raw_price)
    rating = clean_text(rating_el.get_text()) if rating_el else None
    review_count = clean_text(review_count_el.get_text()) if review_count_el else None
    category = clean_text(category_el.get_text()) if category_el else None
    availability = clean_text(availability_el.get_text()) if availability_el else None
    description = clean_text(description_el.get_text()) if description_el else None

    product_id = None
    path = urlparse(product_url).path
    m = re.search(r'(\d+)', path)
    if m:
        product_id = m.group(1)

    return ProductRecord(
        source_url=product_url,
        product_id=product_id,
        name=name,
        price=price,
        currency=currency,
        rating=rating,
        review_count=review_count,
        category=category,
        availability=availability,
        description=description
    )
```

## `cleaner.py`

Here we normalize types, remove duplicates, and create a usable dataset.

```python
import pandas as pd

def clean_dataset(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Basic cleanup
    df = df.copy()

    # Drop duplicates by product URL or ID
    if "source_url" in df.columns:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["source_url"])
    elif "product_id" in df.columns:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_id"])

    # Normalize text columns
    text_cols = ["name", "currency", "category", "availability", "description", "source_url"]
    for col in text_cols:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Convert numeric fields
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df["price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["price"], errors="coerce")

    if "rating" in df.columns:
        df["rating"] = pd.to_numeric(df["rating"], errors="coerce")

    if "review_count" in df.columns:
        # Remove commas and non-digit chars
        df["review_count"] = (
            df["review_count"]
            .astype("string")
            .str.replace(r"[^\d]", "", regex=True)
        )
        df["review_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["review_count"], errors="coerce")

    # Drop obviously empty rows
    df = df.dropna(subset=["name", "price"], how="all")

    # Optional: standardize availability values
    if "availability" in df.columns:
        df["availability"] = df["availability"].fillna("unknown").str.lower()

    return df
```

## `main.py`

This ties everything together.

```python
import json
import os
import pandas as pd

from config import BASE_URL, MAX_PAGES, RAW_OUTPUT_PATH, CLEANED_OUTPUT_PATH
from crawler import crawl_listing_pages
from extractor import extract_product_record
from cleaner import clean_dataset

def ensure_dirs():
    os.makedirs("data/raw", exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs("data/cleaned", exist_ok=True)

def save_jsonl(records, path):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for record in records:
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

def main():
    ensure_dirs()

    print("[pipeline] Crawling product URLs...")
    product_urls = crawl_listing_pages(BASE_URL, max_pages=MAX_PAGES)
    print(f"[pipeline] Found {len(product_urls)} product URLs")

    print("[pipeline] Extracting product records...")
    records = []
    for i, url in enumerate(product_urls, start=1):
        try:
            print(f"[extract] ({i}/{len(product_urls)}) {url}")
            record = extract_product_record(url)
            records.append(record.to_dict())
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[error] Failed to extract {url}: {e}")

    print(f"[pipeline] Extracted {len(records)} records")

    print(f"[pipeline] Saving raw records to {RAW_OUTPUT_PATH}")
    save_jsonl(records, RAW_OUTPUT_PATH)

    print("[pipeline] Cleaning dataset...")
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)
    cleaned_df = clean_dataset(df)

    print(f"[pipeline] Saving cleaned dataset to {CLEANED_OUTPUT_PATH}")
    cleaned_df.to_csv(CLEANED_OUTPUT_PATH, index=False)

    print("[pipeline] Done.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## 6) Parsing layer

This parser assumes a listing page contains product cards with consistent class names. You’ll need to adapt the selectors to the target site.

`parser.py`

```python
import re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from models import ProductRecord

def parse_price(text: str):
    if not text:
        return None, None
    currency_match = re.search(r'([€$£])', text)
    currency = currency_match.group(1) if currency_match else None
    price_match = re.search(r'(\d+(?:[.,]\d{1,2})?)', text)
    if not price_match:
        return None, currency
    price = float(price_match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
    return price, currency

def extract_products_from_listing(html: str, source_url: str):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
    products = []

    # Update these selectors based on the site
    cards = soup.select(".product-card")

    for card in cards:
        name_el = card.select_one(".product-title")
        brand_el = card.select_one(".product-brand")
        category_el = card.select_one(".product-category")
        price_el = card.select_one(".product-price")
        avail_el = card.select_one(".availability")
        rating_el = card.select_one(".rating")
        reviews_el = card.select_one(".review-count")
        link_el = card.select_one("a[href]")

        name = name_el.get_text(strip=True) if name_el else None
        brand = brand_el.get_text(strip=True) if brand_el else None
        category = category_el.get_text(strip=True) if category_el else None
        price_text = price_el.get_text(strip=True) if price_el else None
        price, currency = parse_price(price_text) if price_text else (None, None)
        availability = avail_el.get_text(strip=True) if avail_el else None

        rating = None
        if rating_el:
            try:
                rating = float(rating_el.get_text(strip=True))
            except ValueError:
                rating = None

        review_count = None
        if reviews_el:
            m = re.search(r'\d+', reviews_el.get_text(strip=True))
            review_count = int(m.group()) if m else None

        product_url = link_el["href"] if link_el else source_url

        products.append(
            ProductRecord(
                source_url=product_url,
                product_id=None,
                name=name,
                brand=brand,
                category=category,
                price=price,
                currency=currency,
                availability=availability,
                rating=rating,
                review_count=review_count,
                description=None,
            )
        )

    return products
```

```python
import pandas as pd

def clean_products_dataframe(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()

    # Standardize column names
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]

    # Normalize text fields
    for col in ["name", "brand", "category", "availability", "currency", "description"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

    # Clean price/rating/review_count
    if "price" in df.columns:
        df["price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["price"], errors="coerce")

    if "rating" in df.columns:
        df["rating"] = pd.to_numeric(df["rating"], errors="coerce")

    if "review_count" in df.columns:
        df["review_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["review_count"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

    # Drop rows without essential info
    if "name" in df.columns:
        df = df[df["name"].notna() & (df["name"] != "")]

    # Remove duplicates based on best available keys
    dedupe_cols = [c for c in ["source_url", "name", "brand", "price"] if c in df.columns]
    if dedupe_cols:
        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=dedupe_cols)

    # Reorder common columns
    preferred_order = [
        "source_url", "product_id", "name", "brand", "category",
        "price", "currency", "availability", "rating", "review_count",
        "description"
    ]
    existing_order = [c for c in preferred_order if c in df.columns]
    remaining = [c for c in df.columns if c not in existing_order]
    df = df[existing_order + remaining]

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)
```

```python
import os

def run_pipeline(output_dir="data/processed"):

    for page in range(1, MAX_PAGES + 1):
        url = LISTING_URL_TEMPLATE.format(page=page)
        print(f"Fetching page {page}: {url}")

        try:
            html = fetch_html(url)
            products = extract_products_from_listing(html, source_url=url)
            print(f"  Extracted {len(products)} products")
            all_records.extend([p.to_dict() for p in products])
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  Failed on page {page}: {e}")

    df_raw = pd.DataFrame(all_records)

    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    raw_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "products_raw.csv")

    df_clean = clean_products_dataframe(df_raw)
    clean_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "products_clean.csv")
    df_clean.to_csv(clean_path, index=False)
    print(f"Saved cleaned data to {clean_path}")

    return df_clean
```

## `utils.py`

```python
import re
from urllib.parse import urljoin


def absolute_url(base_url: str, link: str) -> str:
    return urljoin(base_url, link)


def clean_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(value)).strip()
    return value if value else None


def parse_price(text):
    if not text:
        return None, None

    text = text.strip()

    currency = None
    if "$" in text:
        currency = "USD"
    elif "€" in text:
        currency = "EUR"
    elif "£" in text:
        currency = "GBP"

    # Extract numeric part
    match = re.search(r"(\d+(?:[.,]\d{2})?)", text.replace(",", ""))
    if not match:
        return None, currency

    try:
        return float(match.group(1)), currency
    except ValueError:
        return None, currency


def parse_int(text):
    if text is None:
        return None
    match = re.search(r"\d+", str(text).replace(",", ""))
    return int(match.group(0)) if match else None


def parse_rating(text):
    if text is None:
        return None
    match = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", str(text))
    return float(match.group(1)) if match else None
```

```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from utils import absolute_url


class ProductCrawler:
    def __init__(self, base_url, listing_url_template, start_page=1, end_page=1, timeout=20):
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.listing_url_template = listing_url_template
        self.start_page = start_page
        self.end_page = end_page
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update({
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ProductScraper/1.0)"
        })

    def fetch(self, url):
        response = self.session.get(url, timeout=self.timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.text

    def extract_product_links(self, html):
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

        # Update selector for target site
        links = []
        for a in soup.select("a.product-link"):
            href = a.get("href")
            if href:
                links.append(absolute_url(self.base_url, href))
        return links

    def crawl(self):
        all_links = set()

        for page in range(self.start_page, self.end_page + 1):
            listing_url = self.listing_url_template.format(page=page)
            html = self.fetch(listing_url)
            product_links = self.extract_product_links(html)
            all_links.update(product_links)

        return sorted(all_links)
```

```python
import pandas as pd


class DataCleaner:
    def __init__(self):
        pass

    def clean(self, records):
        df = pd.DataFrame([r.to_dict() for r in records])

        # Drop completely empty rows
        df = df.dropna(how="all")

        # Normalize text fields
        for col in ["name", "brand", "availability", "category"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()

        # Standardize availability
        if "availability" in df.columns:
            df["availability"] = (
                df["availability"]
                .fillna("")
                .str.lower()
                .replace({
                    "in stock": "in_stock",
                    "available": "in_stock",
                    "out of stock": "out_of_stock",
                    "sold out": "out_of_stock"
                })
            )

        # Remove duplicates
        subset_cols = ["product_id", "source_url"]
        subset_cols = [c for c in subset_cols if c in df.columns]
        if subset_cols:
            df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=subset_cols)

        # Basic type normalization
        for col in ["price", "rating"]:
            if col in df.columns:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

        if "review_count" in df.columns:
            df["review_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["review_count"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")

        return df
```

```python
import time
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin


class ProductCrawler:
    def __init__(self, base_url, listing_path, headers=None, delay=1.0, timeout=20):
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.listing_path = listing_path
        self.headers = headers or {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ProductCrawler/1.0)"
        }
        self.delay = delay
        self.timeout = timeout

    def fetch(self, url):
        response = requests.get(url, headers=self.headers, timeout=self.timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.text

    def crawl_listing_pages(self, start_page=1, end_page=1):
        product_links = []

        for page in range(start_page, end_page + 1):
            url = f"{self.base_url}{self.listing_path.format(page=page)}"
            html = self.fetch(url)
            soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

            # Adjust selector to match target site
            for a in soup.select("a.product-link"):
                href = a.get("href")
                if href:
                    product_links.append(urljoin(self.base_url, href))

            time.sleep(self.delay)

        return list(dict.fromkeys(product_links))  # dedupe preserving order

    def crawl_product_pages(self, product_urls, parser):
        records = []
        for url in product_urls:
            try:
                html = self.fetch(url)
                record = parser.parse_product_page(html, url)
                records.append(record)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[WARN] Failed to parse {url}: {e}")
            time.sleep(self.delay)
        return records
```

```python
import re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from models import ProductRecord


class ProductParser:
    @staticmethod
    def _text_or_none(el):
        return el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if el else None

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_price(text):
        if not text:
            return None, None
        currency = None
        if "$" in text:
            currency = "USD"
        elif "€" in text:
            currency = "EUR"
        elif "£" in text:
            currency = "GBP"

        m = re.search(r"([0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]{1,2})?)", text)
        if not m:
            return None, currency
        price = m.group(1).replace(",", ".")
        try:
            return float(price), currency
        except ValueError:
            return None, currency

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_int(text):
        if not text:
            return None
        m = re.search(r"\d+", text.replace(",", ""))
        return int(m.group()) if m else None

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_float(text):
        if not text:
            return None
        m = re.search(r"\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?", text)
        if not m:
            return None
        try:
            return float(m.group().replace(",", "."))
        except ValueError:
            return None

    def parse_product_page(self, html, source_url):
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

        # Adjust selectors for the target site
        name = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one("h1.product-title"))
        brand = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".brand-name"))
        price_text = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".price"))
        rating_text = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".rating"))
        reviews_text = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".review-count"))
        availability = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".availability"))
        description = self._text_or_none(soup.select_one(".description"))

        price, currency = self._parse_price(price_text)
        rating = self._parse_float(rating_text)
        review_count = self._parse_int(reviews_text)

        # Optional product ID from meta or DOM
        product_id = None
        meta_id = soup.select_one('meta[name="product-id"]')
        if meta_id and meta_id.get("content"):
            product_id = meta_id["content"]

        return ProductRecord(
            source_url=source_url,
            product_id=product_id,
            name=name,
            brand=brand,
            price=price,
            currency=currency,
            rating=rating,
            review_count=review_count,
            availability=availability,
            description=description,
        )
```

## 4) Crawler

This crawler fetches listing pages and discovers product detail links. It supports simple pagination.

### `crawler.py`
```python
import time
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin

class Crawler:
    def __init__(self, start_urls, delay=1.0, headers=None, timeout=20):
        self.start_urls = start_urls
        self.delay = delay
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.headers = headers or {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; ProductScraper/0.1)"
        }

    def fetch(self, url):
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=self.headers, timeout=self.timeout)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.text

    def discover_product_links(self, html, base_url, product_link_selector="a.product-link"):
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
        links = []
        for a in soup.select(product_link_selector):
            href = a.get("href")
            if href:
                links.append(urljoin(base_url, href))
        return list(dict.fromkeys(links))

    def discover_next_page(self, html, base_url, next_page_selector="a.next"):
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
        a = soup.select_one(next_page_selector)
        if not a:
            return None
        href = a.get("href")
        return urljoin(base_url, href) if href else None

    def crawl_listing_pages(self, listing_selector="a.product-link", next_selector="a.next", max_pages=5):
        all_product_links = []
        visited_pages = set()

        for start_url in self.start_urls:
            current_url = start_url
            pages = 0

            while current_url and current_url not in visited_pages and pages < max_pages:
                visited_pages.add(current_url)
                html = self.fetch(current_url)
                product_links = self.discover_product_links(html, current_url, listing_selector)
                all_product_links.extend(product_links)

                next_url = self.discover_next_page(html, current_url, next_selector)
                current_url = next_url
                pages += 1
                time.sleep(self.delay)

        return list(dict.fromkeys(all_product_links))
```
