```python
        })

            df.loc[df[col].isin(["None", "nan", ""]), col] = pd.NA

    if "price" in df.columns:

    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["name", "url"])
    df = df.dropna(subset=["name", "url"], how="any")

    return df
```

```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import time


BASE_URL = "https://example.com"
START_URL = "https://example.com/products"


def fetch_page(url):
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MinimalScraper/1.0)"
    }
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=20)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.text


def parse_listing_page(html, page_url):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    records = []

    # Adjust selectors to match the target site
    product_cards = soup.select(".product-card")

    for card in product_cards:
        title_el = card.select_one(".product-title")
        price_el = card.select_one(".product-price")
        link_el = card.select_one("a")

        title = title_el.get_text(strip=True) if title_el else None
        price = price_el.get_text(strip=True) if price_el else None
        link = urljoin(page_url, link_el["href"]) if link_el and link_el.get("href") else None

        records.append({
            "title": title,
            "price_raw": price,
            "url": link
        })

    # Find next-page link
    next_el = soup.select_one("a.next")
    next_url = urljoin(page_url, next_el["href"]) if next_el and next_el.get("href") else None

    return records, next_url


def clean_records(df):
    # Drop empty rows
    df = df.dropna(subset=["title", "url"]).copy()

    # Clean title
    df["title"] = df["title"].str.strip()

    # Parse price from strings like "$19.99"
    df["price"] = (
        df["price_raw"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(r"[^0-9.,]", "", regex=True)
        .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
    )
    df["price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["price"], errors="coerce")

    # Remove duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["url"])

    # Keep useful columns
    df = df[["title", "price", "url"]]

    return df


def crawl_products(start_url, max_pages=5, delay=1.0):
    all_records = []
    url = start_url
    page_count = 0

    while url and page_count < max_pages:
        print(f"Fetching: {url}")
        html = fetch_page(url)
        records, next_url = parse_listing_page(html, url)
        all_records.extend(records)

        url = next_url
        page_count += 1
        time.sleep(delay)

    return all_records


def main():
    records = crawl_products(START_URL, max_pages=5, delay=1.0)
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)

    print(f"Scraped {len(df)} raw records")

    cleaned_df = clean_records(df)
    print(f"{len(cleaned_df)} cleaned records")

    cleaned_df.to_csv("products_cleaned.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved to products_cleaned.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    records = []

    for a in soup.select("a.product-card"):
        link = a.get("href")
        if not link:
            continue

        product_url = urljoin(page_url, link)
        title = a.get_text(" ", strip=True)

        records.append({
            "product_url": product_url,
            "listing_title": title
        })

    # Find next page link
    next_page = soup.select_one("a.next")
    next_url = urljoin(page_url, next_page["href"]) if next_page and next_page.get("href") else None

    return records, next_url

def parse_product(html, product_url):
    """
    Extract structured fields from a product detail page.
    Assumes simple selectors:
      - h1.product-title
      - span.price
      - div.description
    """
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

    title_el = soup.select_one("h1.product-title")
    price_el = soup.select_one("span.price")
    desc_el = soup.select_one("div.description")

    title = title_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if title_el else None
    price_raw = price_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if price_el else None
    description = desc_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if desc_el else None

    return {
        "product_url": product_url,
        "title": title,
        "price_raw": price_raw,
        "description": description
    }

def clean_record(record):
    """
    Basic cleanup:
    - normalize whitespace
    - parse numeric price if possible
    """
    def clean_text(x):
        if x is None:
            return None
        x = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", x).strip()
        return x if x else None

    price = None
    if record.get("price_raw"):
        m = re.search(r"([\d.,]+)", record["price_raw"])
        if m:
            price = float(m.group(1).replace(",", ""))

    return {
        "product_url": clean_text(record.get("product_url")),
        "title": clean_text(record.get("title")),
        "description": clean_text(record.get("description")),
        "price": price
    }

def scrape_pipeline(start_url, max_pages=3, delay=1.0):
    """
    Crawl listing pages -> product pages -> clean -> dataset.
    """
    listing_url = start_url
    seen_products = set()
    all_records = []

    for _ in range(max_pages):
        print(f"Fetching listing: {listing_url}")
        listing_html = fetch(listing_url)
        listing_records, next_url = parse_listing(listing_html, listing_url)

        for item in listing_records:
            product_url = item["product_url"]
            if product_url in seen_products:
                continue
            seen_products.add(product_url)

            print(f"  Fetching product: {product_url}")
            product_html = fetch(product_url)
            product_record = parse_product(product_html, product_url)
            cleaned = clean_record(product_record)
            all_records.append(cleaned)

            time.sleep(delay)

        if not next_url:
            break
        listing_url = next_url
        time.sleep(delay)

    df = pd.DataFrame(all_records)

    # Final dataset cleanup
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_url"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df[df["title"].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)

    return df

if __name__ == "__main__":
    df = scrape_pipeline(START_URL, max_pages=5, delay=0.5)
    print(df.head())
    df.to_csv("products_cleaned.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved {len(df)} records to products_cleaned.csv")
```

## 3) Scraper pipeline code

```python
import re
import time
import requests
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin

BASE_URL = "https://example.com"
LISTING_URL = "https://example.com/products?page={page}"

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MinimalScraper/1.0)"
}

def fetch(url):
    """Download a page and return its HTML."""
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=20)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.text

def parse_listing(html, page_url):
    """
    Parse product cards from a listing page.
    Expected HTML structure is generic and may need changing for your site.
    """
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
    records = []

    # Example selectors — adapt these to the target site
    cards = soup.select(".product-card")
    for card in cards:
        name_tag = card.select_one(".product-name")
        price_tag = card.select_one(".product-price")
        link_tag = card.select_one("a")

        name = name_tag.get_text(strip=True) if name_tag else None
        price = price_tag.get_text(strip=True) if price_tag else None
        product_url = urljoin(page_url, link_tag["href"]) if link_tag and link_tag.get("href") else None

        records.append({
            "name": name,
            "price_raw": price,
            "product_url": product_url
        })

    return records

def parse_product_detail(html):
    """Extract additional structured fields from a product page."""
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

    # Generic examples — adapt to your site
    description_tag = soup.select_one(".product-description")
    sku_tag = soup.select_one(".sku")
    category_tag = soup.select_one(".breadcrumb .category")

    return {
        "description": description_tag.get_text(" ", strip=True) if description_tag else None,
        "sku": sku_tag.get_text(strip=True) if sku_tag else None,
        "category": category_tag.get_text(strip=True) if category_tag else None
    }

def clean_price(price_raw):
    """Convert price strings like '$19.99' or 'USD 19.99' into float."""
    if not price_raw:
        return None
    m = re.search(r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)", price_raw.replace(",", ""))
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

def clean_text(text):
    if text is None:
        return None
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text if text else None

def crawl(max_pages=3, delay=1.0):
    """Crawl listing pages and follow product links."""
    all_records = []

    for page in range(1, max_pages + 1):
        listing_url = LISTING_URL.format(page=page)
        print(f"Fetching listing: {listing_url}")

        html = fetch(listing_url)
        listing_records = parse_listing(html, listing_url)

        print(f"Found {len(listing_records)} products on page {page}")

        for rec in listing_records:
            if not rec["product_url"]:
                continue

            try:
                detail_html = fetch(rec["product_url"])
                detail_data = parse_product_detail(detail_html)
                rec.update(detail_data)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Failed to fetch detail page {rec['product_url']}: {e}")

            all_records.append(rec)
            time.sleep(delay)

        time.sleep(delay)

    return all_records

def build_dataset(records):
    """Clean and structure raw scraped records."""
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)

    # Cleaning
    if "name" in df.columns:
        df["name"] = df["name"].apply(clean_text)

    if "description" in df.columns:
        df["description"] = df["description"].apply(clean_text)

    if "category" in df.columns:
        df["category"] = df["category"].apply(clean_text)

    if "sku" in df.columns:
        df["sku"] = df["sku"].apply(clean_text)

    if "price_raw" in df.columns:
        df["price"] = df["price_raw"].apply(clean_price)
        df.drop(columns=["price_raw"], inplace=True)

    # Drop duplicates and rows missing essential fields
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["product_url"])
    df = df[df["name"].notna()]

    return df

def main():
    records = crawl(max_pages=3, delay=1.0)
    df = build_dataset(records)

    print(df.head())

    # Save output
    df.to_csv("output/products.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved {len(df)} records to output/products.csv")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## 4) scraper.py

```python
import time
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin

BASE_URL = "https://example.com/products"  # replace with target site


def fetch_page(url, timeout=15):
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MinimalScraper/1.0)"
    }
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.text


def parse_listing(html, page_url):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    records = []

    # Adjust these selectors to match your site
    cards = soup.select(".product-card")

    for card in cards:
        name_el = card.select_one(".product-title")
        price_el = card.select_one(".product-price")
        link_el = card.select_one("a")

        record = {
            "name": name_el.get_text(strip=True) if name_el else None,
            "price": price_el.get_text(strip=True) if price_el else None,
            "url": urljoin(page_url, link_el["href"]) if link_el and link_el.get("href") else None,
        }

        rating_el = card.select_one(".rating")
        avail_el = card.select_one(".availability")

        record["rating"] = rating_el.get_text(strip=True) if rating_el else None
        record["availability"] = avail_el.get_text(strip=True) if avail_el else None

        records.append(record)

    return records


def crawl_listings(start_page=1, end_page=3, delay=1.0):
    all_records = []

    for page in range(start_page, end_page + 1):
        url = f"{BASE_URL}?page={page}"
        print(f"Fetching: {url}")
        html = fetch_page(url)
        records = parse_listing(html, url)
        print(f"  Found {len(records)} records")
        all_records.extend(records)
        time.sleep(delay)

    return all_records


if __name__ == "__main__":
    data = crawl_listings()
    print(f"Total records collected: {len(data)}")
    print(data[:2])
```

## 5) pipeline.py

This cleans and standardizes the scraped data and writes a CSV.

```python
import re
import json
import pandas as pd


def clean_price(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    match = re.search(r"[\d,.]+", value)
    if not match:
        return None
    return float(match.group(0).replace(",", ""))


def clean_rating(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    match = re.search(r"[\d.]+", value)
    if not match:
        return None
    return float(match.group(0))


def clean_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    value = str(value).strip()
    return value if value else None


def clean_records(records):
    cleaned = []
    seen_urls = set()

    for r in records:
        url = clean_text(r.get("url"))
        if url and url in seen_urls:
            continue
        if url:
            seen_urls.add(url)

        cleaned.append({
            "name": clean_text(r.get("name")),
            "price": clean_price(r.get("price")),
            "rating": clean_rating(r.get("rating")),
            "availability": clean_text(r.get("availability")),
            "url": url,
        })

    return cleaned


def build_dataset(records, output_path="output/products.csv"):
    df = pd.DataFrame(clean_records(records))

    # Basic dataset cleanup
    df = df.dropna(subset=["name", "url"], how="any")
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["url"])
    df = df.sort_values(by=["name"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Save CSV
    df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    print(f"Saved {len(df)} cleaned records to {output_path}")

    return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example: load raw records from JSON file if needed
    with open("raw_records.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        records = json.load(f)

    build_dataset(records)
```

```python
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

def session_with_retries():
    session = requests.Session()
    retries = Retry(
        total=3,
        backoff_factor=1,
        status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
        allowed_methods=["GET"]
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries)
    session.mount("http://", adapter)
    session.mount("https://", adapter)
    session.headers.update({
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MinimalScraper/1.0)"
    })
    return session
```
